items.title: Meta defeats Instagram shopping monopoly lawsuit for now
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: Meta Platforms persuaded a U.S. federal judge to dismiss a lawsuit that accused the company of illegally monopolizing shopping on Instagram by stealing the business plan of a now-defunct startup.
items.body:
Meta Platforms persuaded a U.S. federal judge to dismiss a lawsuit that accused the company of illegally monopolizing shopping on Instagram by stealing the business plan of a now-defunct startup.
Here are the details:
U.S. Magistrate Judge Virginia DeMarchi in San Jose, California, on Friday dismissed claims brought by London-based Ollywan, which had alleged last year that Meta copied its concept for a “tag-based” shopping platform before launching Instagram Shopping in 2016.
Ollywan alleged Meta violated U.S. antitrust law by integrating Instagram with Instagram Shopping, which lets users buy products tagged in posts. Ollywan in 2016 launched Winstag as a photo-sharing app with product tagging and affiliate shopping features. The startup claimed its chief executive shared a business plan with Meta executives under assurances of confidentiality.
DeMarchi said Ollywan's antitrust claims were filed too late and failed to plausibly show harm to competition.
Meta has denied any wrongdoing. “Ollywan seeks to misuse the antitrust laws to blame Meta for the failure of its fledgling app and for succeeding where Ollywan failed,” Meta told the court in a filing.
The lawsuit also challenged Meta's efforts to prevent Ollywan from using the name "Winstag." DeMarchi said "the antitrust laws do not prohibit Meta from enforcing its trademark rights."
Meta had argued that the allegations in the lawsuit occurred outside the four-year window for antitrust claims under federal law. DeMarchi said Ollywan did not explain "how filing this action two years after ceasing operations could be considered a prompt filing."
The judge said she will allow Ollywan to file an amended lawsuit, with limitations.
Meta faces other antitrust lawsuits, including one from a defunct photo-sharing app [USN:L1N3NB0RI TEXT:"that claims"] Meta drove it out of business. Meta last year [USN:L6N3YL18A TEXT:"defeated a lawsuit"] by the Federal Trade Commission that sought to force it to restructure or sell Instagram and WhatsApp. The company has denied the allegations in both cases.
The case is Ollywan Limited v Meta Platforms Inc, U.S. District Court, Northern District of California, No. 5:25-cv-08215.
For plaintiff: Sam Stake and Sami Rashid of Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan
For defendant: Sonal Mehta and David Gringer of Wilmer Cutler Pickering Hale and Dorr

items.title: Bank of Canada set to grapple with renewed trade war pressures in rate decision
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The Bank of Canada finds itself in a familiar dilemma this week as the escalating trade war with the United States casts an uncertain light over Wednesday’s interest rate decision.
items.body: OTTAWA — The Bank of Canada finds itself in a familiar dilemma this week as the escalating trade war with the United States casts an uncertain light over Wednesday’s interest rate decision. The central bank has kept its benchmark rate on hold at 2.25 per cent for nearly a year now. Before trade talks between Canada and the United States fell apart earlier this month, economists and financial markets alike had widely expected the Bank of Canada would stick to the sidelines for the rest of the year and into 2027. Recent tariff volleys have changed the economic context. On Aug. 22, the U.S. imposed 50 per cent tariffs on roughly five per cent of Canadian exports and Canada plans to retaliate with its own counter-tariffs starting Sept. 8. U.S. President Donald Trump has also threatened steeper levies on autos and auto parts starting Jan. 1, 2027. Most economists still believe the Bank of Canada will stick to the status quo as it tries to get a sense of how prices and the economy react to a re-escalating trade war. “The bank has been always hesitant to make a move on rates that they might have to retrace later, because things are so uncertain,” said Tony Stillo, director of Canada economics at Oxford Economics. Financial market odds for a seventh straight hold in the policy rate stood at 99 per cent as of Friday afternoon, according to LSEG Data & Analytics. Over the spring, Bank of Canada governor Tiff Macklem routinely said that if the energy price shock tied to the war in Iran started to show signs of spreading beyond gas pumps, the central bank might be forced to step in with consecutive interest rate hikes to keep inflation tamed. He similarly warned that any tightening of trade restrictions between Canada and the U.S. might push monetary policymakers to instead ease the policy rate. Fresh gross domestic product data from Statistics Canada on Friday showed the economy grew at its fastest pace in more than three years in the second quarter following a year of little growth. But most forecasts, including the Bank of Canada’s outlook, expect that pace to slow somewhat in the second half of the year. “I don’t want to overemphasize the negativity, because it is possible that both sides could de-escalate in the months ahead. But I think we do have to brace for a tough spell for a little while here,” BMO chief economist Doug Porter said in an interview. He said it’s still possible the Canadian and U.S. trade teams reconvene to avoid further escalation in the weeks ahead. But absent a return to the negotiating table, Porter said he’s expecting the third quarter of the year to look much like the early days of the trade war in 2025, when a lack of clarity about tariffs weighed heavily on business activity. While Stillo believes the tariff measures themselves aren’t enough to sink the economy into a recession, he said it’s the uncertainty around the long-term trading relationship with the U.S. that might put a chill on growth. Inflation, meanwhile, has fluctuated sharply in response to gas price volatility. The annual inflation rate has since settled at three per cent as of July, and the central bank’s preferred core inflation metrics have remained well-behaved. Even if the Bank of Canada does assume Canadian jobs or output will take a hit from the latest U.S. tariffs and associated uncertainty, Stillo said monetary policymakers can’t afford to take their eyes off the Middle East war. Canada’s retaliatory tariffs on a range of U.S. goods could also add to inflationary pressures, though Stillo said it’s not clear whether those costs would necessarily get passed on to consumers as businesses grapple with a weak demand environment. In Oxford Economics’ baseline forecast, Canada’s economy continues to grow through to next year, though a few tenths of a percentage point lower than the pace before the latest round of tariffs. In that scenario, Stillo said he expects the Bank of Canada would hold its policy rate steady through 2027. But if the central bank starts to see later this year that the economic slowdown is more pronounced, he said a drop in the policy rate by as much as half a percentage point could be in the cards. While monetary policymakers aren’t expected to rush to cut rates on Wednesday, Stillo said he expects Macklem will lean against market expectations for a return to rate hikes. “We think there’s an easing bias that’s going to be signalled, because they will look at potentially lowering rates if the economy performs, let’s say, weaker than we expect,” Stillo said. Porter said that, absent the new tariff headwinds, the strong second-quarter GDP data would have made the case that rate hikes could be on the horizon. But like Stillo, Porter said he expects the central bank will signal a bias for easing on Wednesday as threats to growth outweigh the risks of resurgent inflation. “The trade battle really does darken the growth outlook. Unless that’s resolved, I think that’s really what they’ve got to focus on, first and foremost,” Porter said. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Aug. 31, 2026. Craig Lord, The Canadian Press

items.title: A FONDO Creciente demanda de medicamentos para adelgazar en Brasil alimenta mercado negro y despierta temores por la salud
items.author: Luciana Magalhaes
items.creator: Luciana Magalhaes
items.summary: Cuando los agentes de aduanas brasileños abrieron unos tarros de dulce de leche a bordo de un autobús turístico procedente de Paraguay en abril, descubrieron cientos de viales de tirzepatida, el principio activo del popular medicamento para adelgazar Mounjaro, mezclados con la preparación.
items.body:
Cuando los agentes de aduanas brasileños abrieron unos tarros de dulce de leche a bordo de un autobús turístico procedente de Paraguay en abril, descubrieron cientos de viales de tirzepatida, el principio activo del popular medicamento para adelgazar Mounjaro, mezclados con la preparación.
La inspección rutinaria se convirtió en una de las mayores incautaciones de medicamentos para adelgazar realizadas en Brasil, con un envío total que superó los 2.500 viales, según la Agencia Tributaria Federal. Pero no fue en absoluto una anomalía.
A lo largo de esa frontera, los agentes están encontrando medicamentos para adelgazar, que forman parte de una clase de fármacos denominados agonistas del receptor del GLP-1, en lugares inesperados.
Los medicamentos ocultos en tubos de escape de motocicletas y suelas de zapatos falsas ponen de relieve los peligros de un auge que ha convertido a Brasil en uno de los mercados más activos del mundo para los fármacos adelgazantes, entre los que se incluyen el Mounjaro de Eli Lilly ( (LLY.N) ) y el Wegovy de Novo Nordisk ( (NOVOb.CO) ), que contiene el principio activo semaglutida.
A las autoridades sanitarias y a los expertos les preocupa que el país pueda ser uno de los más expuestos a las consecuencias no deseadas del auge de los medicamentos para adelgazar, ya que una cultura obsesionada con la belleza, un poder adquisitivo limitado y una aplicación deficiente de la ley empujan a los consumidores hacia inyecciones de contrabando y no autorizadas.
Entre 2018 y mediados de agosto de 2026, las autoridades brasileñas registraron 83 fallecimientos, que están siendo investigados, y más de 3.600 complicaciones relacionadas con medicamentos para adelgazar. Más del 60% de las complicaciones fueron notificadas en 2025 y 2026.
Es probable que las versiones no controladas de estos medicamentos hayan desempeñado un papel significativo. Se prevé que alrededor del 5% de las ventas estimadas de medicamentos para adelgazar en el país este año —que ascienden a 7.000 millones de dólares— procedan de farmacias que preparan mezclas a medida y de productos introducidos de contrabando desde Paraguay, según el banco de inversión Itaú BBA. Reuters no ha podido determinar de forma independiente el papel que han desempeñado las versiones no autorizadas de GLP-1 en esas muertes y complicaciones.
Aunque los expertos manifestaron a Reuters su temor a una crisis de salud pública, tres brasileños afirmaron que los riesgos valen la pena.
"Siempre hay algo de miedo", dijo Taiane Torres da Silva, una peluquera canina de Río de Janeiro que compra un medicamento paraguayo llamado T.G., no autorizado por responsables sanitarios brasileños. "Pero lo hacemos de todos modos porque queremos perder peso".
La autoridad sanitaria de Paraguay, Dinavisa, que autorizó el T.G., dijo en una declaración que ni la institución ni el Gobierno paraguayo son responsables del transporte de medicamentos, aunque reconoció que algunos ciudadanos lo hacen "de forma irresponsable".
El T.G. lo fabrica en Paraguay Laboratorios Indufar CISA, que no respondió a las solicitudes de comentarios.
Las farmacias de Paraguay venden T.G. de forma legal, incluso a brasileños.
Según la agencia reguladora de salud de Brasil, Anvisa, solo los productos de contrabando eluden la evaluación oficial. Los medicamentos "compuestos" mezclados a medida deben cumplir normas técnicas y superar las inspecciones locales.
Andreia Kohout, directora farmacéutica de la Asociación Brasileña contra la Falsificación, señaló no obstante que los consumidores suelen considerar erróneamente que los medicamentos compuestos son idénticos a los de marca. El mercado de medicamentos compuestos, que los influencers promocionan con frecuencia, también cuenta con proveedores poco fiables, añadió.
Al ser consultada sobre el contrabando, los precios y la competencia de los medicamentos no controlados, Eli Lilly dijo que apoya a las autoridades brasileñas en la lucha contra el mercado ilegal para proteger la seguridad de los pacientes. En cuanto a los precios, señaló que sigue buscando formas de aumentar la asequibilidad dentro de unos parámetros legales, regulados y seguros.
"En Brasil, la creciente popularidad de los medicamentos con GLP-1 ha impulsado el mercado de productos preparados a medida, falsificados o importados ilegalmente, que a menudo se venden sin supervisión médica o por fuera de los canales regulados", señaló Novo Nordisk, que añadió que se centra en ofrecer un valor global a través de tratamientos basados en la evidencia, formación, apoyo al paciente, descuentos en programas y una colaboración con un fabricante local.
La proliferación de tratamientos para la pérdida de peso ha consolidado la posición de Brasil como centro mundial de la belleza, junto con Turquía y Corea del Sur. Durante décadas, residentes y turistas han acudido en masa a sus centros de cirugía estética y plástica para someterse a tratamientos, a los que muchos extranjeros pueden acceder a precios atractivos.
La tasa de uso de GLP-1 en Brasil, que se sitúa en el 5,5% de la población, supera el promedio mundial del 3,7%, según la empresa de estudios de mercado Euromonitor International, lo que significa que millones de personas han probado estos tratamientos.
Las incautaciones a nivel nacional de medicamentos ilegales para adelgazar a base de GLP-1 se están disparando, pasando de 609 unidades en 2024 a 60.787 en 2025, según la Asociación contra la Falsificación. Las incautaciones han seguido aumentando considerablemente este año.
AUMENTAN RIESGOS PARA LA SALUD Lo que alarma a algunos expertos y autoridades no es solo el volumen de medicamentos interceptados, sino la forma en que se fabrican y transportan. Dos médicos, un farmacéutico y un funcionario brasileño explicaron a Reuters que un almacenamiento inadecuado y la exposición al calor pueden estropear las inyecciones.
Las prospectos de Mounjaro y Wegovy también señalan el riesgo de pancreatitis aguda, que afecta entre el 0,1% y el 1% de los pacientes. Uno de los médicos dijo que el ayuno prolongado mientras se toman estos medicamentos puede provocar hipoglucemia, aunque esto ocurre en raras ocasiones cuando los medicamentos se utilizan correctamente. Además, la agencia reguladora sanitaria Anvisa ha advertido del riesgo de aspiración y neumonía durante la anestesia, ya que estos medicamentos ralentizan la digestión.
A principios de este año, la autoridad reguladora también señaló un aumento en el número de casos de pancreatitis aguda —que puede derivar en la muerte celular y tisular, e incluso en formas mortales— relacionados con el uso inadecuado de los GLP-1. Dijo que los medicamentos deben utilizarse según lo prescrito, bajo supervisión médica.
El doctor Leonardo Sebba, que trata la obesidad en Goiás, un estado de la región centro-oeste de Brasil, dijo que ha observado cómo algunos pacientes han sufrido estreñimiento grave tras tomar medicamentos para adelgazar que a menudo se obtienen a través de canales no oficiales. El estreñimiento también puede ser un efecto secundario de los medicamentos de marca.
Al menos uno de los pacientes de Sebba tuvo que someterse a una intervención quirúrgica por complicaciones intestinales.
"Por desgracia, la medicación está por todas partes: en las farmacias, pero también en los mercadillos, en las peluquerías, en el gimnasio y entre los vecinos", dijo Sebba. "Realmente se ha convertido —y es una palabra fuerte— en tráfico de drogas".
Las inyecciones ilegales proceden en su mayoría de Paraguay, donde unas leyes de patentes más laxas permiten a las empresas fabricar productos que, de otro modo, solo estarían disponibles como medicamentos de marca más caros.
La autoridad sanitaria de Paraguay señaló que el uso de medicamentos de contrabando en Brasil es competencia de las autoridades brasileñas. La Agencia Tributaria de Brasil dijo que sus funcionarios actúan de forma generalizada para impedir la entrada de mercancías ilegales, pero que no lleva a cabo ninguna operación específica contra los medicamentos para adelgazar.
Los medicamentos ilegales para adelgazar pueden costar una fracción del precio que tienen en las farmacias.
Silva, la peluquera de mascotas de Río, gana el salario mínimo de Brasil, de unos 300 dólares al mes, y compra el medicamento paraguayo para adelgazar T.G. por unos 75 dólares cada seis semanas.
En Brasil, un suministro de cuatro semanas de Mounjaro cuesta unos 290 dólares en su dosis más baja, de 2,5 mg. Una caja de Wegovy en dosis alta, de 2,4 mg, se vende por cerca de 340 dólares en línea a través de un programa de apoyo al paciente. Sus dosis no son comparables porque tienen principios activos diferentes.
ALTERNATIVAS MÁS BARATAS Las autoridades brasileñas esperan que la disponibilidad de medicamentos autorizados para la pérdida de peso más económicos contribuya a que los clientes dejen de recurrir a las inyecciones obtenidas de forma ilegal.
En mayo, la agencia reguladora brasileña aprobó Ozivy, la primera alternativa nacional al Ozempic de Novo Nordisk, que puede venderse por menos de 100 dólares por un suministro de cuatro semanas. Desde entonces, la Anvisa ha aprobado otras marcas.
"Controlar la demanda es difícil", dijo este mes a periodistas el director-presidente de Anvisa, Leandro Safatle. "Pero si esa demanda ya se satisface con un producto regulado y más seguro, con un precio similar al de las importaciones no autorizadas, la gente elegirá naturalmente la opción regulada".
Pamela Erculano Silva, una enfermera de Río de Janeiro que recientemente ha perdido 17 kilos, también utiliza la marca T.G., introducida de contrabando desde Paraguay, porque es asequible y fácil de conseguir a través de un conocido. "Ha transformado por completo mi calidad de vida y mi autoestima", dijo.
Las autoridades están investigando más de 80 muertes relacionadas con medicamentos para adelgazar en Brasil. Flávio Fabres, que dirige la oficina del forense en João Pessoa, en el estado nororiental de Paraíba, revisó uno de estos casos.
Fabres realizó en noviembre la autopsia de Jessica Ataide, de 31 años, quien falleció repentinamente mientras tomaba el medicamento sin consultar a un profesional sanitario, según explicó el profesional. Poco después de tomar una dosis, su nivel de azúcar en sangre se desplomó, lo que le provocó una hipoglucemia grave. Perdió el conocimiento y se asfixió.
"El contenido del estómago se introdujo en sus vías respiratorias, lo que finalmente provocó su muerte por asfixia", explicó Fabres.
La familia de Ataide se negó a hacer comentarios sobre su fallecimiento.
Reuters no pudo determinar qué tipo de medicamento para adelgazar había estado tomando.
Aun así, algunos brasileños afirman que no dejarán de consumirlos.
Vitoria Braga, una residente de Río de Janeiro de 31 años que se inyecta una sustancia para bajar de peso de contrabando junto con su novio y tres familiares, dijo que nunca consultó a un médico, ni siquiera cuando un aumento reciente de la dosis la dejó postrada en cama durante cuatro días con fiebre, náuseas y síntomas parecidos a los de la gripe.
"Ni siquiera sé quién es el proveedor", dijo. "El médico me hubiera dicho que estaba loca y que dejara de tomarlo".

items.title: FDIC defeats $1.71 billion claim over Silicon Valley Bank collapse, US judge rules
items.author: Jonathan Stempel
items.creator: Jonathan Stempel
items.summary: A U.S. judge said the former parent of Silicon Valley Bank cannot pursue a $1.71 billion claim against the FDIC stemming from the bank's March 2023 collapse, one of the largest U.S. bank failures.
items.body:
A U.S. judge said the former parent of Silicon Valley Bank cannot pursue a $1.71 billion claim against the FDIC stemming from the bank's March 2023 collapse, one of the largest U.S. bank failures.
In a 206-page decision on Friday, U.S. District Judge Beth Labson Freeman in San Jose, California, held that a trust that took over the parent's claims was responsible for former executives' ill-fated decisions to try boosting profit by investing heavily in long-term government bonds and mortgage-backed securities.
Silicon Valley Bank collapsed after rising interest rates caused at least $4.52 billion of losses in the bank's investment portfolio, sparking a bank run that disrupted many technology startups whose deposits it held.
Most of the bank's deposits were uninsured. The bank's demise presaged the collapses of two other large lenders in 2023, Signature Bank and First Republic Bank.
Silicon Valley Bank's holding company has been succeeded by SVB Financial Trust. Lawyers for the trust did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Monday. The Federal Deposit Insurance Corp and its lawyers did not immediately respond to similar requests.
'LIVE WITH THE CONSEQUENCES' Freeman said the bank's chief financial officer, treasurer and others acted negligently by taking excessive interest rate and liquidity risks, with encouragement from the board of directors.
She rejected the trust's arguments that it was protected because directors exercised their business judgment in authorizing the investments, and the losses occurred only because the FDIC sold the securities at a loss.
"The holding company chose to run the bank through holding company officers in accordance with the global, enterprise-wide policies, limits, and metrics that the holding company established," Freeman wrote. "Having made this choice, it must live with the consequences."
Freeman ruled after a 12-day, non-jury trial.
Silicon Valley Bank had about $209 billion of assets before it failed.
The FDIC is also [USN:L1N3OC18N TEXT:"suing"] 17 of the bank's former executives and directors, including onetime Chief Executive Gregory Becker, to recover billions of dollars for alleged gross negligence and breaches of fiduciary duty.
Washington Mutual is the largest traditional U.S. bank or thrift by assets to fail, collapsing in 2008. First Republic, Silicon Valley Bank and Signature rank second, third and fourth.

items.title: Bessent says he believes Japan will take action leading to stronger yen
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Monday that he believes the Japanese government and the Bank of Japan will take action that leads to a stronger yen.
items.body:
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Monday that he believes the Japanese government and the Bank of Japan will take action that leads to a stronger yen.
"I have information that the market doesn't have, and it's my belief that the Japanese government and that the BOJ will do the things that will lead to a stronger yen," he said.
When asked whether that meant raising interest rates, Bessent said: "I think the market's pricing that in now."
The yen gained against the dollar after Bessent's comments, which suggested a strong chance the BOJ will raise interest rates at its next policy meeting in September.
The dollar was last down 0.23% at 159.68 yen on Monday.
Bessent was speaking while hosting a Group of 20 finance leaders' gathering in Asheville, North Carolina, which BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda is attending. Bessent had said he was likely to meet Ueda on the sidelines of the meetings.

items.title: How to Fix Our Broken Unemployment System
items.summary:
America’s unemployment insurance system was designed for the workers of the 1920s. It was so utterly inadequate during the pandemic — the most sudden and severe job loss the US has ever seen — that Congress had to build a whole new program even as it was propping up the old one.

Now Americans are afraid of the impact AI will have on their jobs and careers, and a lack of leadership is feeding that fear. If government and elected officials want to be responsive to their constituents, they need to address this anxiety head on. The most direct way to do that is to build a new program to help workers who are looking for a job.

Bloomberg Opinion columnist and economist Kathryn Anne Edwards has a solution to our broken unemployment system. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: PG&E Falls on Liability Bill; Nvidia Rises on Chip Investment | Stock Movers
items.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- PG&E (PGE) are extending their downward move as California legislators introduced a bill that would update the state’s wildfire response without shifting liability away from publicly traded utilities. items.title: Orçamento de 2027 vai prever superávit primário real de R$19 bilhões, diz Moretti
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O projeto de Lei Orçamentária Anual (PLOA) de 2027 vai prever um superávit primário de aproximadamente R$19 bilhões, um resultado real e “cheio”, independentemente de descontos previstos na contabilização da meta fiscal, disse nesta segunda-feira o ministro do Planejamento e Orçamento, Bruno Moretti.
items.body:
O projeto de Lei Orçamentária Anual (PLOA) de 2027 vai prever um superávit primário de aproximadamente R$19 bilhões, um resultado real e “cheio”, independentemente de descontos previstos na contabilização da meta fiscal, disse nesta segunda-feira o ministro do Planejamento e Orçamento, Bruno Moretti.
Falando em evento promovido pelo BTG Pactual, Moretti afirmou que as contas de 2027 contarão com uma economia de R$20 bilhões em gastos obrigatórios por causa da ativação de gatilhos de ajuste fiscal aprovados pelo governo.
Será ativada no próximo ano uma limitação de alta real de despesas com pessoal a 0,6% após o governo ter registrado déficit fiscal em 2025. Além disso, um projeto [USN:L1N44915D TEXT:"aprovado"] neste mês limita o crescimento de gastos obrigatórios não previstos na Constituição.
"Essa desaceleração da despesa obrigatória não é uma promessa vã... A gente tem os instrumentos já aprovados", disse. "Nós temos uma perspectiva real de entregar um resultado primário superavitário, equilibrado."
A execução do orçamento de 2027, que será apresentado pelo governo nesta segunda-feira, prazo final para envio do texto ao Congresso Nacional, não dependerá da aprovação de novas medidas arrecadatórias, ressaltou.
O ministro reafirmou que o governo se compromete a promover um ajuste fiscal de 2 pontos percentuais do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) no próximo mandato se o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for reeleito. Ele ressaltou que esse esforço manteria o atendimento à parcela da população que mais precisa.
Perguntado sobre a possibilidade de avaliar uma mudança na política de valorização do salário mínimo ou uma desvinculação dos reajustes de benefícios previdenciários, Moretti disse que esses debates não estão "na ordem do dia" do governo ou da campanha de Lula.

items.title: 習主席とプーチン氏、SCO首脳会議で会談－インド・イラン首脳会談も
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国の習近平国家主席とロシアのプーチン大統領は31日、キルギスで開かれた上海協力機構（SCO）首脳会議に合わせて会談した。

ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官は国営テレビの記者に対し、両首脳は貿易や経済協力を含む2国間関係と主要な国際問題を中心に協議し、ウクライナ戦争についてはわずかに触れた程度だったと述べた。

インドのモディ首相とイランのペゼシュキアン大統領も同日、キルギスの首都ビシケクで会談した。両首脳の会談は、米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争が始まって以来初めて。

モディ首相はXへの投稿で「幅広い分野で、インドとイランの長年にわたる友好関係を強化するというわれわれの決意を改めて表明した。今後、貿易品目を拡大し、多様化したい」と述べた。

SCOは2001年、中国とロシアが中央アジアのカザフスタン、ウズベキスタン、タジキスタン、キルギスとともに設立した。その後、インド、パキスタン、イラン、ベラルーシが加盟。アフガニスタンとモンゴルがオブザーバー国となっているほか、サウジアラビア、トルコ、エジプト、アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）など15カ国が「対話パートナー」となっている。

世界銀行のデータによると、加盟国は世界人口の40%超、世界の国内総生産（GDP）の約4分の1を占める。

SCOは近年、大幅に拡大してきたものの、加盟国間の対立もあり、設立から25年を迎える中、こうした地政学的な野心を世界で具体的な行動につなげる仕組みの構築にはほとんど成功していない。

イランと米国の対立は、SCOが足並みをそろえて行動できない実態を浮き彫りにする恐れがあり、各国首脳による対応は象徴的な連帯表明にとどまる可能性が高い。習主席もプーチン大統領もイランを軍事的に支援する姿勢を示しておらず、経済支援も限定的となっている。

モディ首相とプーチン大統領も31日中に会談する予定。インドはロシアやイランなど長年の友好国との関係と、通商協定を巡る交渉を進めているトランプ米大統領との関係との間で、バランスを取ろうとしている。

items.title: China's CXMT makes breakthrough in advanced memory chips, the Information reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT has begun producing advanced high-bandwidth memory in small quantities, the Information reported on Monday.
items.body:
Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT (688825.SS) has begun producing advanced high-bandwidth memory in small quantities, the Information reported on Monday.
CXMT is making HBM3E, an advanced type of high-bandwidth memory that is used in AI chipsets, the report said, citing two people familiar with the matter.
The company plans to expand production in 2027, according to the report.
Several Chinese chip designers, including Alibaba Group’s T-Head and Beijing-based Cambricon Technologies, are testing the memory with their processors, the report said.
These companies will use CXMT’s memory in products as early as next year if all goes to plan, the report said.
CXMT, Cambricon and Alibaba’s T-Head were not immediately available for comment.

items.title: Presidente chinês diz a Putin que as bases das relações bilaterais ficarão mais sólidas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, afirmou nesta segunda-feira ao presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, que, sob a “orientação estratégica e esforços conjuntos” deles, os alicerces das relações bilaterais ficarão mais sólidos, com perspectivas mais promissoras, segundo informou a agência estatal chinesa Xinhua.
items.body:
O presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, afirmou nesta segunda-feira ao presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, que, sob a “orientação estratégica e esforços conjuntos” deles, os alicerces das relações bilaterais ficarão mais sólidos, com perspectivas mais promissoras, segundo informou a agência estatal chinesa Xinhua.
“As incertezas e os fatores imprevisíveis no cenário internacional aumentaram significativamente”, disse Xi, acrescentando que a busca das pessoas por paz, desenvolvimento e cooperação permanece inalterada.
A China está disposta a trabalhar com a Rússia e outros países para “fortalecer as forças que lideram a reforma da governança global e promovem um mundo multipolar igualitário e ordenado”, disse Xi durante a reunião realizada à margem da cúpula da Organização de Cooperação de Xangai (OCS) no Quirguistão.
Os dois também discutiram questões internacionais e regionais de interesse comum, informou a Xinhua.

items.title: Mercados financieros argentinos en alza, inversores atentos a cuestiones externas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El mercado de acciones de Argentina operaba en alza el lunes, donde se destacaba la mejora en papeles del sector energético pese a la cautela de los inversores tras el avance del precio del crudo a nivel global por la reanudación del conflicto en Oriente Medio.
items.body:
El mercado de acciones de Argentina operaba en alza el lunes, donde se destacaba la mejora en papeles del sector energético pese a la cautela de los inversores tras el avance del precio del crudo a nivel global por la reanudación del conflicto en Oriente Medio.
El precio del crudo se negociaba en torno a 90 dólares el barril, luego de que el enfrentamiento entre Estados Unidos e Irán se intensificará el fin de semana, mientras el conflicto entre ambos países se prolonga ya por sexto mes.
"Después de una pausa de más de un mes en las acciones militares, las fuerzas estadounidenses atacaron el domingo dos unidades lanzacohetes en la isla iraní de Larak", expresó la consultora Max Capital.
"En represalia, la Guardia Revolucionaria Islámica atacó dos bases estadounidenses en Jordania. Trump extendió hoy sus amenazas militares a la isla de Kharg, principal terminal iraní de exportación de petróleo", agregó.
El índice bursátil local, el S&P Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires, mejoraba un 0,66% a las 1425 GMT. Las acciones de la petrolera estatal YPF (YPFDm.BA) avanzaban un 1,8%.
Por su parte, los bonos en el segmento extrabursátil subían un 0,2% promedio, mientras que el riesgo país, elaborado por el banco JPMorgan, se ubicaba en 512 puntos básicos.
"Luego de tres semanas de rigurosa contención (del tipo de cambio), las autoridades aflojaron el techo informal para dar mayor holgura al mercado y mitigar la presión sobre las tasas de interés", afirmó la consultora Wise Capital.
El peso interbancario operaba con una leve apreciación del 0,13% a 1.510,5 unidades por dólar.
"La defensa estricta del valor anterior (1.500 pesos) afectaba severamente la liquidez e impactaba en la actividad económica" añadió.
Wise Capital remarcó que "no obstante, el Banco Central (BCRA) no abandonó del todo la regulación del mercado. La entidad mantuvo su presencia activa mediante intervenciones en el mercado de futuros y en bonos vinculados al dólar. Esta dinámica evidencia un esquema de flotación más flexible pero administrado".
La entidad monetaria compró 82 millones de dólares el viernes, con lo que acumuló 256 millones de dólares en la semana y adquirió más de 14.000 millones de dólares en lo que va del año.

items.title: 米株下落、中東緊張激化で原油高－円は対ドル159円台後半に小幅上昇
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 31日午前の米株式相場は下落。地政学リスク上昇を受けて原油が急伸し、インフレ圧力の強まりで米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が利上げに動くとの見方が広がった。

中東情勢の緊迫化を受け、北海ブレント原油11月限は前週末比で約3％高い1バレル＝90ドル台で取引されている。ウエスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）先物は1バレル＝85ドル台半ばで推移している。

エネルギー価格の上昇を背景に、米10年債利回りは4.75%を上回り、2025年1月以来、約1年7カ月ぶりの高水準となった。S&P500種株価指数は8月の月間上昇率を縮小した。

米国とイランは約1カ月ぶりに攻撃を応酬した。米軍がホルムズ海峡の島を攻撃したのに対し、イランはアラブ首長国連邦（UAE）とヨルダンへの攻撃で応じた。トランプ米大統領はFOXニュースに対し、イランの攻撃に米国は応じると述べたが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

外国為替市場では、ブルームバーグ・ドル・スポット指数が小反落。円相場は米東部時間午前10時12分現在、対ドルでニューヨーク前週末比0.2%高の1ドル＝159円82銭で推移している。

items.title: Sony e Warner Music processam Anthropic por uso de músicas no treinamento de IA
items.author: Blake Brittain
items.creator: Blake Brittain
items.summary: As divisões editoriais musicais da Sony Music e da Warner Music entraram com uma ação contra a Anthropic no tribunal federal da Califórnia, nos Estados Unidos, pelo suposto uso indevido de suas composições musicais protegidas por direitos autorais para treinar seu modelo de inteligência artificial Claude.
items.body:
As divisões editoriais musicais da Sony Music (6758.T) e da Warner Music (WMG.O) entraram com uma ação contra a Anthropic no tribunal federal da Califórnia, nos Estados Unidos, pelo suposto uso indevido de suas composições musicais protegidas por direitos autorais para treinar seu modelo de inteligência artificial Claude.
A Sony e a Warner afirmaram na ação, movida na sexta-feira, que a Anthropic pirateou centenas de letras de músicas e partituras dos Beatles, Taylor Swift, Michael Jackson e centenas de outros artistas para treinar o Claude a responder a solicitações humanas.
A ação judicial é a mais recente de uma onda de processos movidos contra empresas de tecnologia por detentores de direitos autorais — incluindo autores, editoras, gravadoras e veículos de comunicação — em relação ao uso de suas obras para treinar sistemas de IA. A Universal Music Group (UMG.AS) processou a Anthropic em 2023 pelo suposto uso de letras de músicas protegidas por direitos autorais no treinamento de IA, em um processo que ainda está em andamento.
A Anthropic se tornou a primeira empresa de IA a chegar a um acordo em uma dessas disputas no ano passado, quando pagou US$1,5 bilhão para resolver uma ação coletiva movida por um grupo de autores.
“A Anthropic claramente considera isso apenas o custo de se fazer negócios, já que todo o seu modelo de negócios continua sendo construído com base na violação de direitos autorais”, afirmaram a Sony e a Warner em sua ação. “E US$1,5 bilhão obviamente não é um valor de acordo alto o suficiente para dissuadir a conduta infratora de uma empresa que transformou essa violação em massa em uma avaliação astronômica de US$2 trilhões.”
Porta-vozes da Anthropic, da Sony Music e da Warner Music não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário nesta segunda-feira.
A denúncia alega que a Anthropic obteve ilegalmente as letras e partituras das editoras por meio de downloads de torrent para treinar o Claude, e que o Claude é capaz de reproduzir letras protegidas por direitos autorais “literalmente” quando solicitado.
A Sony e a Warner também afirmaram que a Anthropic usou suas letras para ensinar o Claude a “gerar vastas quantidades de letras de músicas supostamente ‘novas’, geradas por IA, que competem com as obras legítimas protegidas por direitos autorais das editoras musicais como substitutos prejudiciais no mercado”.
As gravadoras buscam indenização de até US$150.000 por cada direito autoral violado e uma ordem judicial proibindo a Anthropic de usar suas obras.
(Reportagem de Blake Brittain, em Washington)

FAST

Aug 31 : Meta has agreed to improve how it verifies the age of users of its platforms such as Facebook and Instagram as part of an $18 billion legal settlement with U.S. states that is aimed at curbing children's use of social media.
Here is a look at what Meta said it will do to ensure that users are as old as they say they are, and some of the legal issues that could complicate age checks.
HOW HAS META DETERMINED AGES UNTIL NOW? 
Meta policy bars children under 13 from using Facebook or Instagram and permits teenagers to use the platforms with some limits on content. Meta has acknowledged that younger users sometimes lie about their ages when creating accounts, and the company has faced increasing pressure from countries around the world to limit children's access to social media.

Meta has not historically asked users for proof of age such as a photo ID. Instead the company said it looks at contextual clues, like birthday posts or celebrations of school grades, to identify accounts that are being used by children. 
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg testified in February that age verification would be more effective if it was handled by makers of mobile devices, an approach taken by a Texas state law that requires people under 18 to get parental consent before downloading an age-restricted app onto their device.
Meta agreed to the multi-state settlement, announced on August 26, to resolve legal claims that it designed social media platforms to addict children.
WHAT CHANGES MUST META MAKE TO CHECK AGES? 
The settlement requires Meta to make broad changes related to users under 18, such as setting daily usage limits and disabling push notifications at night. It also calls for stronger age checks for young users, but it does not require Meta to take strict verification steps such as checking the photo IDs of users or asking them to upload a video selfie.
The settlement focuses particular attention on age checks for children below age 13, requiring Meta to take extra steps such as searching the friend networks of the accounts of the youngest users in an effort to identify and eliminate them. The company must also make it easier for social media users to report suspected children's accounts, and it allows an independent auditor to review Meta's efforts to check ages. 
The settlement allows Meta to temporarily use some data generated by children it identifies in order to train an AI model to detect under-13 users in the future, similar to its current approach for identifying the accounts of suspected teenagers. 
WHAT ARE THE LEGAL HURDLES IN DETERMINING AGES?
Meta has previously described both legal and practical roadblocks to stricter age assurance, including a 1998 federal law called the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act, or COPPA. This statute holds companies liable for damages if they collect personal data from children under age 13 without parental consent.
Meta and other social media companies have argued that this law puts them in a bind because it restricts them from collecting from children the kind of data that would reliably verify a person's age, such as IDs, biometric information or detailed records of their online activity.
Experts who advocate for better protections for children online have argued that social media companies have tried to use COPPA as a distraction to avoid taking responsibility for allowing children onto their platforms.
DOES THE SETTLEMENT ADDRESS CHILDREN'S PRIVACY?
The $18 billion settlement, as well as a $942 million judgment in a New Mexico court case on August 6, have attempted to thread the needle, requiring more proactive age-verification measures without triggering potential violations of COPPA. 
In New Mexico, the judge concluded that the online-privacy law restricted him from ordering Meta to ask children to submit personal data or be passively tracked online, and said that strict age-verification requirements could put Meta at an unfair disadvantage to social media competitors. So the judge ordered changes intended to improve age assurances "within the limits of COPPA." The settlement uses a similar approach.
The Federal Trade Commission, which enforces COPPA for the U.S. government, issued a policy statement in February that it would not take action against any company that collects personal information for the sole purpose of determining a user's age via age-verification technologies.

Aug 31 : Meta has agreed to improve how it verifies the age of users of its platforms such as Facebook and Instagram as part of an $18 billion legal settlement with U.S. states that is aimed at curbing children's use of social media.
Here is a look at what Meta said it will do to ensure that users are as old as they say they are, and some of the legal issues that could complicate age checks.
HOW HAS META DETERMINED AGES UNTIL NOW? 
Meta policy bars children under 13 from using Facebook or Instagram and permits teenagers to use the platforms with some limits on content. Meta has acknowledged that younger users sometimes lie about their ages when creating accounts, and the company has faced increasing pressure from countries around the world to limit children's access to social media.

Meta has not historically asked users for proof of age such as a photo ID. Instead the company said it looks at contextual clues, like birthday posts or celebrations of school grades, to identify accounts that are being used by children. 
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg testified in February that age verification would be more effective if it was handled by makers of mobile devices, an approach taken by a Texas state law that requires people under 18 to get parental consent before downloading an age-restricted app onto their device.
Meta agreed to the multi-state settlement, announced on August 26, to resolve legal claims that it designed social media platforms to addict children.
WHAT CHANGES MUST META MAKE TO CHECK AGES? 
The settlement requires Meta to make broad changes related to users under 18, such as setting daily usage limits and disabling push notifications at night. It also calls for stronger age checks for young users, but it does not require Meta to take strict verification steps such as checking the photo IDs of users or asking them to upload a video selfie.
The settlement focuses particular attention on age checks for children below age 13, requiring Meta to take extra steps such as searching the friend networks of the accounts of the youngest users in an effort to identify and eliminate them. The company must also make it easier for social media users to report suspected children's accounts, and it allows an independent auditor to review Meta's efforts to check ages. 
The settlement allows Meta to temporarily use some data generated by children it identifies in order to train an AI model to detect under-13 users in the future, similar to its current approach for identifying the accounts of suspected teenagers. 
WHAT ARE THE LEGAL HURDLES IN DETERMINING AGES?
Meta has previously described both legal and practical roadblocks to stricter age assurance, including a 1998 federal law called the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act, or COPPA. This statute holds companies liable for damages if they collect personal data from children under age 13 without parental consent.
Meta and other social media companies have argued that this law puts them in a bind because it restricts them from collecting from children the kind of data that would reliably verify a person's age, such as IDs, biometric information or detailed records of their online activity.
Experts who advocate for better protections for children online have argued that social media companies have tried to use COPPA as a distraction to avoid taking responsibility for allowing children onto their platforms.
DOES THE SETTLEMENT ADDRESS CHILDREN'S PRIVACY?
The $18 billion settlement, as well as a $942 million judgment in a New Mexico court case on August 6, have attempted to thread the needle, requiring more proactive age-verification measures without triggering potential violations of COPPA. 
In New Mexico, the judge concluded that the online-privacy law restricted him from ordering Meta to ask children to submit personal data or be passively tracked online, and said that strict age-verification requirements could put Meta at an unfair disadvantage to social media competitors. So the judge ordered changes intended to improve age assurances "within the limits of COPPA." The settlement uses a similar approach.
The Federal Trade Commission, which enforces COPPA for the U.S. government, issued a policy statement in February that it would not take action against any company that collects personal information for the sole purpose of determining a user's age via age-verification technologies.
Legal experts said that the FTC policy provides only a partial shield for companies because U.S. states have their own authority to enforce COPPA violations even when the FTC declines to do so.
Several states had sued Meta, alleging online-privacy violations, but dropped those claims as part of the settlement.

items.title: Saudi AI firms Humain, DataVolt partner for data center on kingdom's Red Sea coast
items.author: Federico Maccioni
items.creator: Federico Maccioni
items.summary: Saudi Arabia-backed artificial intelligence company Humain has partnered with digital infrastructure firm DataVolt to develop around 100 megawatts (MW) of the first phase of a planned data center at Oxagon, an industrial city under development in NEOM, on the kingdom's Red Sea coast, NEOM said in a statement on Monday.
items.body:
Saudi Arabia-backed artificial intelligence company Humain has partnered with digital infrastructure firm DataVolt to develop around 100 megawatts (MW) of the first phase of a planned data center at Oxagon, an industrial city under development in NEOM, on the kingdom's Red Sea coast, NEOM said in a statement on Monday.
The facility is expected to be available in 2028, integrating renewable energy sources, innovative cooling technologies, and high-performance computing clusters.
It will form part of the 360 MW first phase of DataVolt’s planned AI data centre campus at Oxagon. The development is part of a wider 1.5 gigawatt (GW) AI campus.
Firms expect the project to benefit from Oxagon’s pre-zoned industrial land availability, at-scale energy resources, and access to low-latency computing via subsea cable connectivity.
Saudi Arabia and its Gulf peers are accelerating their AI build-out to capitalise on surging global demand for computing power.
Set up last year and backed by Saudi Arabia's wealth fund PIF, [USN:L6N41Q17N TEXT:"Humain"] has secured several agreements with global technology firms. It is targeting 6 GW of capacity by 2034.
The kingdom is pouring hundreds of billions of dollars to transform its economy and cut reliance on oil revenue, investment in various sectors including AI.
NEOM was unveiled a decade ago as a futuristic urban project part of the transformation but plans have been [USN:L6N3WA0R0 TEXT:"scaled back"] amid cost overruns, lower-than-anticipated global oil prices in recent years.
Oxagon is set to host renewable‑energy manufacturing and AI‑driven industries, with a [USN:L6N41S0N9 TEXT:"port"] that authorities are now positioning as part of a faster regional trading corridor amid the Iran war.

items.title: Want NSE shares before the IPO? Here’s how the unlisted market works
items.author: Kumar Gaurav
items.summary: The National Stock Exchange’s anticipated IPO nears, prompting investors to consider buying unlisted shares now or waiting for the public offering. Unlisted trading involves private negotiations and off-market transfers through specialized platforms before the exchange-based listing occurs.
items.body: The much-awaited initial public offering (IPO) of the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) could be closer to launch, leaving investors with two routes to gain exposure to the exchange: buy its shares in the pre-IPO, unlisted market or wait for the public issue.Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey on August 27 said the market regulator was close to clearing the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) filed by NSE, the world’s largest derivatives exchange by trading volume.NSE filed its draft prospectus in June for an IPO that will comprise entirely of an offer for sale (OFS), allowing existing shareholders to pare their stakes. The exchange had initially expected SEBI clearance for its DRHP by early August. The timeline was subsequently pushed back by around three weeks following changes to the roster of selling shareholders, with SBI Capital Markets being added.At the top end of the marketed valuation of Rs 5.26 lakh crore ($55 billion), NSE would rank sixth among global exchange operators by market capitalisation, narrowly behind London Stock Exchange Group Plc and ahead of Nasdaq Inc, according to Bloomberg.NSE unlisted share priceNSE’s unlisted shares are currently changing hands at around Rs 1,970, according to data from Unlisted Arena. The shares were quoted at around Rs 2,010 when NSE filed its DRHP.Over the past year, the unlisted stock has traded in a range of around Rs 1,800-2,150, well below its June 2025 peak of Rs 2,590.The shares had slipped to around Rs 1,950 on July 28-29 before recovering to current levels.ALSO READ: NSE IPO coming soon: Should investors buy unlisted shares now or wait for the mega issue?With NSE’s IPO expected in the second half of September, investors are now assessing whether to enter the stock through the unlisted market or wait for the public offering and its eventual listing.How to buy NSE unlisted sharesNSE shares currently trade in the unlisted, over-the-counter market, where investors can acquire equity in companies ahead of their listing on recognised stock exchanges.Unlike a listed stock, NSE’s unlisted shares do not have a continuous exchange-based price discovery mechanism or a live market price. Trades are negotiated privately between buyers and sellers, with the final transaction price depending on the prevailing quote and available liquidity.Investors looking to acquire NSE shares can approach SEBI-registered investment banks, brokers or specialised unlisted-share dealers. These intermediaries facilitate transactions by matching investors seeking to buy pre-IPO shares with existing shareholders looking to sell.Investors can also purchase shares directly from existing shareholders, including promoters, founders, angel investors and employees holding vested ESOPs. Such transactions are generally negotiated over the counter and may involve sizeable minimum ticket sizes.Pre-IPO platforms also aggregate such opportunities and facilitate the KYC, price discovery and share-transfer process.Step-by-step process to buy NSE unlisted sharesChoose an intermediary or platform: Register with a specialised unlisted-share platform or dealer offering NSE shares.Complete KYC: Submit documents including PAN, Aadhaar, bank account details and the Client Master Report (CMR/CML) issued by your depository participant. The CMR contains details such as your demat account, DP ID, Client ID and linked bank account.Check the quote and lot size: Unlike an exchange-traded stock, there is no central order book or exchange-determined price for NSE’s unlisted shares. Buyers and sellers negotiate the transaction price and quantity, with intermediaries facilitating the trade.Place the order and make payment: Once the price and quantity are agreed upon, the buyer transfers funds through the payment channel specified by the platform, including UPI, NEFT, RTGS or a designated escrow account.Complete the transfer documentation: Depending on the transaction, documentation may include the share purchase agreement (SPA), delivery instruction slip (DIS), proof of payment and transfer deed (SH-4).Receive the shares in the demat account: Once the transaction is verified and the seller confirms the transfer, the shares are moved through an off-market transfer and credited to the buyer’s demat account through the depository system. The shares may typically be credited within 24 to 48 business hours, according to the details provided.The two depositories, CDSL and NSDL, oversee the electronic transfer of shares. Proper documentation is critical to establishing the transfer of title, as unlisted transactions do not pass through the standard order-matching and settlement mechanism of a stock exchange.(Disclaimer: Recommendations, suggestions, views and opinions given by the experts are their own. These do not represent the views of Economic Times)

items.title: Indiens Wirtschaft wächst unerwartet stark um 7,8 Prozent - Sorgen wegen Ölpreis
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Indiens Wirtschaft ist im Frühjahrsquartal mit 7,8 Prozent auf Jahressicht stärker gewachsen als erwartet. Angetrieben wurde die nach China und Japan drittgrößte Volkswirtschaft Asiens von einem Investitionsboom, starker Industrieproduktion sowie solider Konsumnachfrage, wie aus am Montag veröffentlichten Regierungsdaten hervorgeht. Von Reuters befragte Ökonomen hatten nur mit einem Plus von 7,1 Prozent gerechnet, die indische Zentralbank mit sieben Prozent. So legten die privaten Investitionen um fast zwölf Prozent zu, nach 5,8 Prozent vor Jahresfrist. Von Januar bis März war die indische Wirtschaft um 8,6 Prozent gewachsen.
items.body:
Indiens Wirtschaft ist im Frühjahrsquartal mit 7,8 Prozent auf Jahressicht stärker gewachsen als erwartet. Angetrieben wurde die nach China und Japan drittgrößte Volkswirtschaft Asiens von einem Investitionsboom, starker Industrieproduktion sowie solider Konsumnachfrage, wie aus am Montag veröffentlichten Regierungsdaten hervorgeht. Von Reuters befragte Ökonomen hatten nur mit einem Plus von 7,1 Prozent gerechnet, die indische Zentralbank mit sieben Prozent. So legten die privaten Investitionen um fast zwölf Prozent zu, nach 5,8 Prozent vor Jahresfrist. Von Januar bis März war die indische Wirtschaft um 8,6 Prozent gewachsen.
Ministerpräsident Narendra Modi sprach auf der Plattform X von einer "herkulesartigen Leistung". "Schwarzseher wurden eines Besseren belehrt und Indien blühte auf ... schon wieder!", erklärte er.
Experten sehen jedoch auch Risiken, die das Wachstum trüben könnten. Als größte Gefahr gelten die hohen Ölpreise infolge des Konflikts zwischen den USA und dem Iran. Denn Indien importiert fast 85 Prozent seines Rohölbedarfs. Zudem könnten in puncto Währung eine schwache Rupie und straffere globale Finanzbedingungen die Aussichten belasten.
"Die Hauptrisiken liegen jetzt weniger in einer schwächeren Binnennachfrage als vielmehr in anhaltend hohen Ölpreisen", sagte Radhika Rao, leitende Volkswirtin bei der DBS Bank. Dennoch sei ein Wachstum von mehr als sieben Prozent für das Gesamtjahr sehr wahrscheinlich. Die indische Zentralbank (RBI) hatte wegen der Inflationsrisiken zuletzt die Möglichkeit einer Zinserhöhung im weiteren Jahresverlauf signalisiert.

Der Auftrag hat ein Volumen von 387,8 Millionen Euro und ist der bislang größte für die ehemalige Sparte des kriselnden IT-Konzerns Atos. Der französische Staat hat sich als strategisch wichtig betrachtete Teile des Konzerns gesichert. Daraus formte er vor wenigen Monaten Bull AI.
items.body:
Die Europäische Union (EU) hat beim französischen Staatsunternehmen Bull AI einen Hochleistungsrechner für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) bestellt. Der Auftrag hat ein Volumen von 387,8 Millionen Euro und ist der bislang größte für die ehemalige Sparte des [USN:L8N3YM0HJ TEXT:"kriselnden IT-Konzerns"] Atos (ATOS.PA) . Der französische Staat hat sich als strategisch wichtig betrachtete Teile des Konzerns gesichert. Daraus formte er vor wenigen Monaten Bull AI.
Das Unternehmen soll für EuroHPC, die Supercomputer-Behörde der EU, einen KI-Hochleistungsrechner in einem bestehenden Rechenzentrum in Finnland installieren. Dieser wird seinen Betrieb voraussichtlich in der zweiten Jahreshälfte 2027 aufnehmen. Ausgestattet mit einem Milliardenbudget, hat EuroHPC bislang 19 KI-Rechenzentren mit rund einem Dutzend Supercomputern eingerichtet. Dieses Netzwerk, zu dem auch der Hochleistungsrechner "Jupiter" im Forschungszentrum Jülich gehört, werde in den kommenden Jahren erweitert, weil die Nachfrage das Angebot übersteige, betonte Evangelos Floros, der Infrastruktur-Chef der EU-Behörde. Die von EuroHPC geförderten Computersysteme werden unter anderem für das Training europäischer KI verwendet.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［アッシュビル（米ノースカロライナ州）　３１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［アッシュビル（米ノースカロライナ州）　３１日　ロイター］ - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォーシュ議長は３１日、２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）の財務相・中銀総裁らに対し、投資が世界的に急増しており、これが成長を後押しし、投資機会の不足で資本が滞留していた過去の「貯蓄過剰」を逆転させているとの認識を示した。

ウォーシュ議長は、２００８年の世界金融危機前を含む過去のＧ２０会合や、それ以降の数年間においても、参加者は「世界的な貯蓄過剰」について議論していたはずだが、状況は一転したと指摘。「今の状況を特徴づけるなら、それは『世界的な投資の急増』の局面だ」とし、長期停滞という概念はもはや当てはまらないとの見方を示した。

同議長がＧ２０財務相・中央銀行総裁会議に出席するのは、５月の就任以来、初となる。

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: I principali indici azionari statunitensi sono in calo dopo che gli attacchi militari tra Stati Uniti e Iran hanno spinto al rialzo i prezzi del petrolio, alimentando i timori di inflazione, già accesi dalle dichiarazioni "restrittive" del presidente della Fed Kevin Warsh nel suo primo discorso a Jackson Hole la settimana scorsa.
items.body:
I principali indici azionari statunitensi sono in calo dopo che gli attacchi militari tra Stati Uniti e Iran hanno spinto al rialzo i prezzi del petrolio, alimentando i timori di inflazione, già accesi dalle dichiarazioni "restrittive" del presidente della Fed Kevin Warsh nel suo primo discorso a Jackson Hole la settimana scorsa.
** Alle 16.35 ore italiane il Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) scende dello 0,8%, l’S&P 500 (.SPX) perde lo 0,6% e il Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) arretra dello 0,56%.
** I servizi di pubblica utilità (.SPLRCU) guidano i ribassi a livello di settori, registrando un calo dell’1,7% dopo che un emendamento a un disegno di legge del Senato californiano non ha sostanzialmente modificato l'esposizione dei gestori di rete alle responsabilità per i danni da incendi boschivi.
** PG&E (PCG.N) crolla del 19% e, se le perdite dovessero persistere, sembra destinata a chiudere la giornata con il peggior risultato degli ultimi sei anni.
** NVIDIA (NVDA.O) avanza dell'1,02%, sovraperformando rispetto ai titoli megacap. Anche altri produttori di chip guadagnano terreno. INTEL (INTC.O) e TEXAS INSTRUMENTS (TXN.O) guadagnano rispettivamente lo 0,53% e lo 0,9%.
** Tra gli altri titoli in movimento, le azioni di GAMESTOP (GME.N) salgono del 3,5% dopo che la società ha detto che rimborserà circa il 27% dell'ammontare previsto in un'operazione di scambio di debito/cash da 1,4 miliardi di dollari, precedentemente comunicato, attingendo alla liquidità disponibile anziché emettendo nuove azioni, evitando così un'ulteriore diluizione del capitale.

items.title: Meta entfernt in Indien Online-Werbung für Schadsoftware
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Der Internetkonzern Meta hat Dutzende betrügerische Online-Anzeigen entfernt. Das Unternehmen reagierte damit auf Hinweise der indischen Behörden, denen zufolge Nutzer mithilfe pornografischer Inhalte auf den Meta-Plattformen Facebook und Instagram dazu verleitet wurden, Schadsoftware herunterzuladen. Dadurch konnten sich die Täter Zugangsdaten zu Bankkonten erschleichen und unbemerkt Gelder abziehen. Staatlichen indischen Angaben zufolge summierte sich der Schaden durch Internetbetrug im Jahr 2025 auf 2,4 Milliarden Dollar.
items.body:
Der Internetkonzern Meta (META.O) hat Dutzende betrügerische Online-Anzeigen entfernt. Das Unternehmen reagierte damit auf Hinweise der indischen Behörden, denen zufolge Nutzer mithilfe pornografischer Inhalte auf den Meta-Plattformen Facebook und Instagram dazu verleitet wurden, Schadsoftware herunterzuladen. Dadurch konnten sich die Täter Zugangsdaten zu Bankkonten erschleichen und unbemerkt Gelder abziehen. Staatlichen indischen Angaben zufolge summierte sich der Schaden durch Internetbetrug im Jahr 2025 auf 2,4 Milliarden Dollar.
Unmittelbar nach der Warnung der Behörden am Montag waren einer Recherche der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters zufolge mindestens 39 derartige Anzeigen mit Namen wie "Kyss" oder "Night Play" aktiv. Viele von ihnen warben mit sexuellen Darstellungen um Klicks. Kurz nachdem Reuters das Unternehmen hierauf aufmerksam gemacht und um Stellungnahme gebeten hatte, verschwanden die monierten Anzeigen. Auf die Bitte um einen Kommentar reagierte Meta nicht.
Die Geschäftsbedingungen des Konzerns verbieten pornografische Inhalte in Anzeigen. Zudem darf nicht für betrügerische Produkte oder Dienstleistungen geworben werden. Internen Unterlagen zufolge stammen rund zehn Prozent von Metas Werbeeinnahmen aus [USN:L8N3WI2TL TEXT:"betrügerischen Anzeigen"]. Vor einigen Wochen hatten die indischen Behörden die Alphabet (GOOGL.O) -Tochter Google angewiesen, Hunderte Nutzerkonten der Entwicklerplattform Firebase zu löschen. Kriminelle hätten diese genutzt, um sich als Bank auszugeben und Kunden zu betrügen.

items.summary: Eni , le compagnie Usa Chevron e GE Vernova , l'indiana ONGC (India) e la colombiana GeoPark sono vicine alla firma di accordi definitivi in Venezuela, dopo mesi di negoziati volti a concretizzare progetti energetici nel Paese membro dell’Opec.
items.body:
Eni (ENI.MI) , le compagnie Usa Chevron (CVX.N) e GE Vernova (GEV.N) , l'indiana ONGC (ONVI.NS) (India) e la colombiana GeoPark (GPRK.N) sono vicine alla firma di accordi definitivi in Venezuela, dopo mesi di negoziati volti a concretizzare progetti energetici nel Paese membro dell’Opec.
Lo hanno riferito quattro fonti vicine alla vicenda.
Gli accordi, che potrebbero essere siglati già nel corso di questa settimana, si accompagnano a una più ampia intesa tra Caracas e Washington annunciata la scorsa settimana, con cui gli Stati Uniti si sono assicurati una partecipazione in 17 giacimenti petroliferi, per circa 64 miliardi di barili di riserve accertate, pari a un quinto delle riserve totali di greggio del Venezuela.
Eni ha detto che sta collaborando con le controparti venezuelane e con le autorità competenti per "sostenere la rivitalizzazione del settore energetico del Paese".
Chevron, GE Vernova, ONGC e GeoPark non hanno risposto al momento alle richieste di commento.

items.title: Honda e Nissan planejam software automotivo conjunto para 2029
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As montadoras japonesas Nissan e Honda anunciaram nesta segunda-feira que desenvolverão em conjunto unidades de controle eletrônico (ECUs) padronizadas para veículos definidos por software (SDVs), aprofundando colaboração em tecnologias automotivas mais avançadas.
items.body:
As montadoras japonesas Nissan (7201.T) e Honda (7267.T) anunciaram nesta segunda-feira que desenvolverão em conjunto unidades de controle eletrônico (ECUs) padronizadas para veículos definidos por software (SDVs), aprofundando colaboração em tecnologias automotivas mais avançadas.
As duas montadoras planejam introduzir uma arquitetura que incorpore as ECUs e software desenvolvidos em conjunto nos veículos de próxima geração a partir do ano fiscal de 2029, afirmaram em comunicado.
O software tornou-se um importante campo de batalha para as montadoras, à medida que os veículos passam a incorporar mais funções de direção autônoma e conectividade. As montadoras estão investindo pesadamente em sistemas operacionais que suportam recursos que vão desde assistência ao motorista e entretenimento até atualizações, o que aumenta os custos de desenvolvimento.
A iniciativa também reflete a crescente pressão competitiva de montadoras chinesas, como a BYD (002594.SZ) , que ganharam espaço em mercados como a Europa e o Sudeste Asiático com carros elétricos e híbridos repletos de recursos de software avançados.
O acordo é resultado de negociações iniciadas em 2024, quando Honda e Nissan anunciaram que pesquisariam conjuntamente plataformas de software de última geração. Ele surge mais de um ano depois que as empresas abandonaram negociações de fusão que teriam criado a quarta maior montadora do mundo.
Honda e Nissan afirmaram que pretendem estabelecer especificações comuns para as ECUs (unidades de controle eletrônico) centrais dentro da arquitetura elétrica e eletrônica de seus veículos, bem como para os sistemas operacionais e partes do software de controle veicular.
A Mitsubishi Motors (7211.T) , parceira da Nissan na aliança, afirmou que está considerando aderir à colaboração e continua em discussões com as duas montadoras sobre possíveis áreas de cooperação.
(Por Daniel Leussink)

items.title: Índia prevê chuvas abaixo do normal em setembro, após um agosto fraco
items.author: Rajendra Jadhav
items.creator: Rajendra Jadhav
items.summary: A Índia provavelmente terá chuvas de monção abaixo da média em setembro, depois que a precipitação em agosto ficou 16% abaixo do normal, informou o departamento meteorológico nesta segunda-feira, gerando preocupações quanto à produtividade agrícola e ao crescimento econômico da terceira maior economia da Ásia.
items.body:
A Índia provavelmente terá chuvas de monção abaixo da média em setembro, depois que a precipitação em agosto ficou 16% abaixo do normal, informou o departamento meteorológico nesta segunda-feira, gerando preocupações quanto à produtividade agrícola e ao crescimento econômico da terceira maior economia da Ásia.
A escassez de chuvas durante setembro -- mês crucial para o amadurecimento das culturas -- pode prejudicar a produtividade das culturas semeadas no verão, como algodão, soja, milho e leguminosas, além de reduzir a umidade do solo necessária para as culturas semeadas no inverno, incluindo trigo e canola.
A previsão é de que as chuvas de setembro fiquem abaixo de 91% da média de longo prazo, disse Mrutyunjay Mohapatra, diretor-geral do Departamento Meteorológico da Índia.
Também se espera que as temperaturas médias máximas e mínimas permaneçam acima do normal em setembro devido à escassez de chuvas, disse Mohapatra.
A monção é responsável por cerca de 70% da precipitação anual da Índia e reabastece reservatórios, rios e lençóis freáticos na economia de quase US$4 trilhões, onde quase metade das terras agrícolas carece de irrigação e cerca de metade da população depende da agricultura para sua subsistência.
Mohapatra disse que o fenômeno climático El Niño, que contribuiu para a redução das chuvas em agosto, intensificou-se ainda mais.
O El Niño é caracterizado por temperaturas da superfície do mar excepcionalmente altas na região central e oriental do Oceano Pacífico equatorial, o que perturba os padrões climáticos em todo o mundo e frequentemente traz condições mais secas para partes da Ásia.
A Índia já registrou precipitação abaixo da média em muitos anos anteriores marcados pelo El Niño, o que, em algumas ocasiões, provocou secas severas que prejudicaram as safras e levaram a restrições nas exportações de alguns grãos.

items.title: Wall Street cae por alza del crudo y expectativas de política monetaria restrictiva de la Fed
items.author: Niket Nishant, Utkarsh Hathi
items.creator: Niket Nishant, Utkarsh Hathi
items.summary: Los principales índices bursátiles estadounidenses caían el lunes, tras unos ataques militares entre Estados Unidos e Irán que provocaron un repunte del precio del crudo, avivando los temores inflacionarios tras comentarios de línea dura del presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, el viernes en su primer discurso en Jackson Hole.
items.body:
Los principales índices bursátiles estadounidenses caían el lunes, tras unos ataques militares entre Estados Unidos e Irán que provocaron un repunte del precio del crudo, avivando los temores inflacionarios tras comentarios de línea dura del presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, el viernes en su primer discurso en Jackson Hole.
* Estas caídas podrían marcar la tónica para septiembre, un mes que suele ser débil para la renta variable, y es probable que aumenten la presión de cara a la reunión de la Fed del próximo mes.
* Los operadores ven más de un 60% de probabilidades de una subida de tasas de interés en septiembre, según FedWatch de CME, frente al 41,4% de hace una semana, después de que Warsh afirmara que las autoridades monetarias podrían verse obligadas a aumentar los costos de financiación si la inflación no se modera hasta el objetivo del 2%.
* "Él (Warsh) descartó por completo cualquier posibilidad de un recorte (de tasas)", dijo Thomas Kikis, de Standard Chartered.
* Los comentarios de Warsh ocurrieron tras los datos dispares de las últimas semanas. Un reporte sobre la inflación al consumidor publicado este mes reveló que las presiones sobre los precios fueron moderadas en julio, pero el índice de gastos de consumo personal -el indicador preferido por la Fed- fue mayor a lo esperado.
* Esta ambigüedad podría elevar la importancia del reporte mensual de empleo de Estados Unidos, que se publicará el 4 de septiembre. Los reportes recientes no indicaban que "las tendencias subyacentes hubieran mejorado de forma significativa", señaló Warsh el viernes.
* El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) perdía 350,75 puntos, o un 0,65%, a 53.209,24 unidades; el índice S&P 500 (.SPX) caía 30,49 puntos, o un 0,4%, a 7.681,27 unidades; y el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) restaba 77,11 puntos, o un 0,29%, a 26.325,31 unidades.
* El referencial S&P 500 y el Nasdaq, con gran peso tecnológico, se encaminan a ganancias mensuales tras dos meses seguidos a la baja, mientras que el Dow apunta a su quinta alza mensual seguida.

items.body:
O presidente do Conselho de Estabilidade Financeira (FSB, na sigla em inglês), Andrew Bailey, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que o impacto da IA no risco cibernético é a preocupação mais imediata para o sistema financeiro global, observando que a tecnologia poderia alterar a velocidade, a escala e os aspectos econômicos de um ataque.
O FSB é um órgão regulador global que busca identificar e gerenciar riscos nos sistemas financeiros.
Em carta aos ministros de Finanças e presidentes de bancos centrais do G20 antes das reuniões desta semana, Bailey, que também atua como presidente do Banco da Inglaterra, afirmou que muitos países não dispõem de sistemas para gerenciar a implantação de modelos avançados de inteligência artificial.
A dependência do setor financeiro de um punhado de poderosos provedores de tecnologia poderia minar a confiança do mercado em todo o sistema, acrescentou.
Os comentários destacaram as preocupações entre os reguladores de que a IA avançada possa acelerar a descoberta de vulnerabilidades cibernéticas, forçando correções mais rápidas e criando potenciais desafios operacionais e de resiliência caso os processos de teste e recuperação não consigam se adaptar com segurança.
Os comentários vêm na esteira da implementação rigidamente controlada pelo governo dos EUA do poderoso modelo Mythos, da Anthropic, que chegou a restringir seu uso exclusivamente a cidadãos norte-americanos.
“Desenvolvimentos recentes destacam a importância de garantir que os avanços em capacidade sejam acompanhados por resiliência e preparação”, disse Bailey.
Apoiar o lançamento seguro e responsável de modelos “em nível global” deve ser uma prioridade, acrescentou.
Em julho, um agente da OpenAI escapou de um ambiente de testes controlado e invadiu a empresa de IA Hugging Face, gerando preocupações sobre a possibilidade de sistemas de inteligência artificial contornarem as medidas de segurança.
Bailey reiterou alertas anteriores sobre o risco de possíveis correções de mercado, citando avaliações exageradas no setor de IA e fragilidades nos mercados de dívida pública. No início deste mês, o Tesouro norte-americano interveio para limitar os rendimentos dos Treasuries de longo prazo, que haviam atingido máximas em várias décadas.
Bailey também citou como uma preocupação emergente o aumento do uso de alavancagem nos mercados de ações.

items.title: Foreign buying in Indian stocks hits 23-month high in August, RBI data shows
items.author: Bharath Rajeswaran
items.creator: Bharath Rajeswaran
items.summary: Foreign portfolio investors poured $3.1 billion into Indian equities in August, the highest monthly inflow in nearly two years, aided by domestic companies' strong earnings outlook and the central bank's measures to stabilise the rupee.
items.body:
Foreign portfolio investors poured $3.1 billion into Indian equities in August, the highest monthly inflow in nearly two years, aided by domestic companies' strong earnings outlook and the central bank's measures to stabilise the rupee.
FPIs were net buyers for a second consecutive month, with their purchases in August being the largest since September 2024, National Securities Depository data showed on Friday.
Still, they remain on course for the highest-ever annual outflows from the country, with net sales worth $24.6 billion in the year so far, following a shift to markets with pure-play AI-linked companies such as Taiwan and South Korea earlier this year.
Concerns about the impact of a surge in oil prices on India's inflation also pressured foreign buying, considering the country is the world's third-largest crude importer.
Benchmarks Nifty (.NSEI) and Sensex (.BSESN) are down 7.8% and 9.7% in 2026 so far, among the worst-performing Asian and emerging markets.
The [USN:L4N43W0L6 TEXT:"trend, however, has reversed since July"] on worries that the companies making those massive investments in AI infrastructure may not reap their profits soon.
The Reserve Bank of India's [USN:L4N42G1HH TEXT:"measures to support the rupee and attract foreign money into debt markets"], alongside a robust June-quarter earnings season, have also aided sentiment.
Profit after tax for Nifty 50 (.NSEI) companies rose by [USN:L4N44F0B9 TEXT:"the highest in 10 quarters"], according to at least five brokerages. Several brokerages such as Motilal Oswal and PhillipCapital have since upgraded their fiscal year 2027 earnings expectations.
"The key takeaway for domestic and foreign investors is that demand remains healthy, has beaten expectations and is continuing beyond the June quarter," said Hiren Dasani, chief investment officer for emerging markets at Singapore-based WhiteOak Capital.
Dasani said the RBI also seemed to have attracted sufficient forex inflows, considering the early closure of a special dollar-rupee swap window for banks that were raising foreign currency deposits from the diaspora.
The addition to the RBI's dollar buffer could ease concerns around rupee volatility, a key consideration for foreign investors, he said.
"It should be treated as a sign of strength that the central bank has got enough dollars now, rather than a weakness, with the ability to stabilise the rupee on a much better footing now."
Despite renewed foreign buying, weakness in heavyweights such as HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) and Reliance Industries (RELI.NS) dragged the Nifty and Sensex down 1.2% and 1.5% in August.
The broader markets fared better, with nine of 16 major sectors posting monthly gains and the small-cap (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-cap (.NIFMDCP100) indexes rising 3.1% and 2.1%, respectively, to record highs.
