items.title: Queda no lucro da Huawei acelera para 36% no primeiro semestre com alta de custos e gastos com pesquisa
items.author: Eduardo Baptista
items.creator: Eduardo Baptista
items.summary: A chinesa Huawei Technologies divulgou, nesta segunda-feira, uma queda de 36% no lucro líquido do primeiro semestre, já que o aumento vertiginoso dos custos dos insumos e os gastos mais elevados com pesquisa e desenvolvimento superaram o crescimento da receita.
items.body:
A chinesa Huawei Technologies divulgou, nesta segunda-feira, uma queda de 36% no lucro líquido do primeiro semestre, já que o aumento vertiginoso dos custos dos insumos e os gastos mais elevados com pesquisa e desenvolvimento superaram o crescimento da receita.
A gigante de tecnologia e telecomunicações sediada em Shenzhen informou que o lucro líquido de janeiro a junho caiu para 23,81 bilhões de iuanes (US$3,54 bilhões), acelerando em relação à queda de 32% registrada no mesmo período do ano anterior, enquanto a receita cresceu 9,6%, para 467,82 bilhões de iuanes, à medida que a empresa continuava se recuperando das sanções impostas pelos Estados Unidos.
Os resultados destacam o custo do esforço da Huawei para reduzir a dependência de tecnologia estrangeira e expandir suas capacidades em computação de inteligência artificial e chips, após anos de restrições de exportação dos EUA. O aumento dos preços dos chips de memória também pesou na lucratividade de sua divisão de negócios de consumo, que inclui smartphones.
A Huawei informou que os gastos com pesquisa e desenvolvimento aumentaram 25,2%, para 121,38 bilhões de iuanes, o equivalente a 25,9% da receita, à medida que intensificou os investimentos em IA, tecnologia de comunicações, dispositivos inteligentes e soluções automotivas inteligentes.
O custo de fabricação dos produtos da empresa subiu 12,4%, um ritmo mais rápido do que o crescimento da receita, enquanto os custos administrativos também aumentaram acentuadamente.
A empresa afirmou que seus resultados do primeiro semestre estavam em linha com suas previsões, mas que suas perspectivas para o ano inteiro continuam sob revisão devido à incerteza externa e aos custos mais elevados dos insumos.
A Huawei, cujos negócios incluem smartphones, chips de IA e equipamentos de telecomunicações, não informou a receita por segmento de negócios. A empresa afirmou que todos os seus negócios registraram crescimento da receita em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior no primeiro semestre.
A companhia apresentou uma forte recuperação na receita desde que as sanções e os controles de exportação dos EUA restringiram seu acesso a chips avançados e ao sistema operacional Android do Google, o que contribuiu para uma queda de 29% na receita anual em 2021.
A Huawei, um dos grupos de tecnologia chineses mais fortemente afetados pelas restrições dos EUA, vem, desde então, investindo maciçamente no desenvolvimento de alternativas nacionais em chips, software e infraestrutura de computação de IA. Sua receita em 2025 cresceu 2,2%, para 880,9 bilhões de iuanes, seu segundo maior total anual após o recorde de 891 bilhões de iuanes em 2020.
Este ano, a Huawei promoveu produtos de telecomunicações com foco em IA, novos equipamentos de computação e tecnologia de direção autônoma, ao mesmo tempo em que lançou novos smartphones, tablets e dispositivos vestíveis na China e no exterior.
Os gastos com bens e serviços cresceram muito mais rapidamente do que os recursos recebidos com as vendas, enquanto os estoques aumentaram 42% em relação ao final de 2025.
O aumento dos gastos com pesquisa e desenvolvimento e as mudanças no mix de negócios da empresa também pesaram sobre a lucratividade, informou a Huawei.
(Reportagem de Eduardo Baptista)

items.title: Sweden inks French war ship order
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Sweden's defence material administration on Monday signed an order for four Naval Group navy frigates during a ceremony in Stockholm attended by French President Emmanuel Macron and Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson.
items.body:
Sweden's defence material administration on Monday signed an order for four Naval Group navy frigates during a ceremony in Stockholm attended by French President Emmanuel Macron and Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson.
Sweden in May [USN:L8N41W0DJ TEXT:"said it would order"] the vessels from the French company in a $4 billion deal that will triple its air defence capacity in the face of security threats in the Baltic Sea.
Sweden, NATO's newest member, is racing to build up its military in the wake of Russia's invasion of Ukraine. The first of the four new frigates, which will be the Swedish navy's biggest ships, is expected to be delivered in 2030.
The deal comes as France and Sweden deepen defence ties, pushing for greater European military self-reliance at a time when doubts over U.S. President Donald Trump's commitment to Europe are prompting governments across the continent to rethink their dependence on American weapons and security guarantees.

items.title: ChatGPT, Reddit e Roblox passarão a seguir regras da UE para plataformas de grande porte
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Comissão Europeia anunciou nesta segunda-feira que ChatGPT, Reddit e Roblox deverão cumprir as regulamentações da UE para plataformas online de porte muito grande e mecanismos de busca.
items.body:
A Comissão Europeia anunciou nesta segunda-feira que ChatGPT, Reddit e Roblox deverão cumprir as regulamentações da UE para plataformas online de porte muito grande e mecanismos de busca.
Esses serviços declararam que atingem pelo menos 45 milhões de usuários mensais na UE.
Isso os qualifica para a designação de “muito grandes” nos termos da Lei dos Serviços Digitais da União Europeia, afirmou a Comissão.
ChatGPT, Reddit e Roblox têm quatro meses para cumprir as obrigações adicionais decorrentes dessa designação.
Isso inclui avaliar e mitigar os riscos de disseminação de conteúdo ilegal por meio de suas plataformas.
Elas também precisam mitigar os efeitos negativos sobre menores e sobre o bem-estar físico e mental dos usuários.
As plataformas e os mecanismos de busca de “porte muito grande” também precisam limitar os riscos aos direitos fundamentais, aos processos eleitorais e à segurança pública.
A Comissão pode supervisionar o cumprimento da Lei dos Serviços Digitais (DSA) e passará a ter poderes de investigação para avaliar as funcionalidades por trás dos serviços.
O sistema de IA ChatGPT se enquadra como um mecanismo de busca online nos termos da DSA.
A plataforma de jogos Roblox e a plataforma de discussão Reddit são consideradas plataformas online, pois permitem que os usuários divulguem conteúdo de terceiros ao público.

items.title: Against Angels, Yankees RHP Elmer Rodriguez continues pursuit of maiden win
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Still in search of his first major league victory, right-hander Elmer Rodriguez will take the mound on Monday night when the New York Yankees open a three-game series with the struggling Los Angeles Angels on Monday night in Anaheim, Calif.
items.body:
Still in search of his first major league victory, right-hander Elmer Rodriguez will take the mound on Monday night when the New York Yankees open a three-game series with the struggling Los Angeles Angels on Monday night in Anaheim, Calif.
It will be the sixth career start for the hard-throwing 23-year-old Rodriguez (0-2, 4.70 ERA), who is rated the Yankees' top pitching prospect (No. 3 overall) by MLB Pipeline.
Rodriguez was recalled from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre to fill the rotation spot created when Ryan Weathers was placed on the 15-day injured list Aug. 23 with a left forearm flexor strain.
Rodriguez started four games earlier in the season. His first start since being recalled came Wednesday in a 9-3 win against the Houston Astros when he allowed three runs on three hits in a career-best six-plus innings, but he didn't pick up a decision. He walked two and struck out six while averaging 97.2 mph with his sinker.
"He was nasty," Yankees manager Aaron Boone said. "That's what we get excited about right there. I think he got their attention right away. You're seeing 97, 98, 99 (mph) sinkers filling up the zone, spinning a good breaking ball. Man, that was really encouraging to see."
"I know I have the stuff to go out there and compete," said Rodriguez, who received a standing ovation when he departed after issuing a leadoff walk to Jose Altuve to begin the seventh inning. "I know I have the stuff to do that."
Rodriguez will face a Los Angeles team that tied its season-high seven-game losing streak with a 5-2 loss to the Philadelphia Phillies on Sunday and is tied with the Colorado Rockies for the worst record in baseball (52-85).
The Angels are batting a woeful .195 during the seven-game streak while scoring just 21 runs and allowing 35. Since the All-Star break, the Angels are batting a MLB-worst .218.
"We come here to win every single day," Los Angeles manager Kurt Suzuki said after the loss on Sunday. "Obviously, there's frustration, whatever you want to call it, but at the end of the day, the pitching has been really good. We've been in every single game pretty much and have had a chance to win every game. You try to look at the positives going forward. ... If you become too negative sometimes, it's not going to help."
One big positive for the Angels has been the performance of rookie right-hander Walbert Urena (8-9, 2.94), who will start the series opener.
Urena, who has not faced the Yankees, leads the current roster in wins and ERA and is second to Reid Detmers in strikeouts with 112 in 116 1/3 innings. Opposing hitters are batting just .203 against him, the lowest by an Angels starter.
The Yankees, winners of 10 of their past 14 games, come in off a 16-1 thumping of the Boston Red Sox on Sunday to take three of four games in that series. Perhaps more importantly, New York also won the season series, 7-6, which serves as a tiebreaker to determine home field advantage should the two rivals meet in the postseason.
Reigning American League MVP Aaron Judge, out since May 31 with a right rib fracture, is accompanying the club for its six-game Southern California trip, which concludes with three games in San Diego, to continue his rehab. Boone said Judge potentially could take some on-field batting practice.
"I'm sure it will be ramped up and a lot more involved," Boone said. "He'll start to get on velocity and things like that. He'll be part of the pregame stuff and just get more entrenched into getting ready to come back."
--Field Level Media

items.author: CNA

Aug 31 : The music publishing branches of Sony Music and Warner Music have sued Anthropic in California federal court for allegedly misusing their copyrighted song compositions to train its Claude AI models.
Sony and Warner said in the complaint, filed on Friday, that Anthropic pirated hundreds of song lyrics and sheet music from The Beatles, Taylor Swift, Michael Jackson and hundreds of other artists to train Claude to respond to human prompts.
The lawsuit is the latest in a wave of cases brought against tech companies by copyright owners including authors, publishers, music labels and news outlets over the use of their work to train AI systems. Universal Music Group sued Anthropic in 2023 over the alleged use of copyrighted song lyrics in AI training, in a lawsuit that is still ongoing.
Anthropic became the first AI company to settle one of the disputes last year, when it paid $1.5 billion to resolve a class action from a group of authors.

"Anthropic clearly considers that to be just the cost of doing business given that its entire business model continues to be built on copyright theft," Sony and Warner said in their complaint. "And $1.5 billion is obviously not a large enough settlement to deter infringing conduct by a company that has parlayed such mass infringement into a staggering $2-trillion-dollar valuation."
Spokespeople for Anthropic, Sony Music and Warner Music did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Monday.
The complaint alleges Anthropic illegally obtained the publishers' lyrics and sheet music through torrent downloads to train Claude, and that Claude can reproduce copyrighted lyrics "verbatim" when prompted.
Sony and Warner also said Anthropic used their lyrics to teach Claude to "generate vast quantities of purportedly 'new' AI-generated song lyrics, which compete with Music Publishers’ legitimate copyrighted works as harmful market substitutes."
The labels are seeking damages of up to $150,000 for each infringed copyright and a court order barring Anthropic from using their works.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Peru seeks to lead UN labour body amid funding shortfall
items.author: Emma Farge
items.creator: Emma Farge
items.summary: Peru has entered the race to lead the International Labour Organization, its website showed on Monday, as the body grapples with a financial shortfall that may force it to cut jobs.
items.body:
Peru has entered the race to lead the International Labour Organization, its website showed on Monday, as the body grapples with a [USN:L6N3VV0B2 TEXT:"financial shortfall"] that may force it to cut jobs.
Peru has nominated its former Foreign Affairs Minister Javier Gonzalez-Olaechea to lead the ILO, a letter posted on the ILO website showed.
Spain has also nominated Labour Minister Yolanda [USN:L6N43P0Z8 TEXT:"Diaz"] and they will both run against current head, Togo's Gilbert Houngbo, who is seeking a second term.
In his mission statement, Gonzalez-Olaechea, who worked at the ILO for two decades, pledged reform and to help protect dignity in the workplace amid major disruptions caused by artificial intelligence and automation.
Candidates' hearings are planned in November, followed by a secret ballot. The new Director-General's term begins in October 2027.
The ILO, like the wider UN system, is facing a challenging financial and liquidity situation due to delayed assessed contributions.
The U.S. has outlined plans to not pay its ILO contributions for the next fiscal year. Long the largest contributor, the U.S. owes 257 million Swiss francs ($315 million) in assessed contributions and arrears as of July.
The ILO's governing body will discuss possible job cuts in a meeting next month. A draft document showed it proposes to cut up to 120 full-time positions for the 2026-2027 period, or around 7% of the workforce.

The music publishing branches of Sony Music (6758.T) and Warner Music (WMG.O) have sued Anthropic in California federal court for allegedly misusing their copyrighted song compositions to train its Claude AI models.
Sony and Warner said in the complaint , filed on Friday, that Anthropic pirated hundreds of song lyrics and sheet music from The Beatles, Taylor Swift, Michael Jackson and hundreds of other artists to train Claude to respond to human prompts.
The lawsuit is the latest in a wave of cases brought against tech companies by copyright owners including authors, publishers, music labels and news outlets over the use of their work to train AI systems. Universal Music Group (UMG.AS) [USN:L1N3BO1X6 TEXT:"sued Anthropic"] in 2023 over the alleged use of copyrighted song lyrics in AI training, in a lawsuit that is still ongoing.
Anthropic became the first AI company to settle one of the disputes last year, when it [USN:L6N41W171 TEXT:"paid $1.5 billion"] to resolve a class action from a group of authors.
"Anthropic clearly considers that to be just the cost of doing business given that its entire business model continues to be built on copyright theft," Sony and Warner said in their complaint. "And $1.5 billion is obviously not a large enough settlement to deter infringing conduct by a company that has parlayed such mass infringement into a staggering $2-trillion-dollar valuation."
Spokespeople for Anthropic, Sony Music and Warner Music did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Monday.
The complaint alleges Anthropic illegally obtained the publishers' lyrics and sheet music through torrent downloads to train Claude, and that Claude can reproduce copyrighted lyrics "verbatim" when prompted.
Sony and Warner also said Anthropic used their lyrics to teach Claude to "generate vast quantities of purportedly 'new' AI-generated song lyrics, which compete with Music Publishers’ legitimate copyrighted works as harmful market substitutes."
The labels are seeking damages of up to $150,000 for each infringed copyright and a court order barring Anthropic from using their works.
items.raw_description: The music publishing branches of Sony Music and Warner Music have sued Anthropic in California federal court for allegedly misusing their copyrighted song compositions to train its Claude AI models.

items.title: Wall Street recua sob pressão de alta do petróleo e apostas sobre o Fed
items.author: Niket Nishant, Utkarsh Hathi
items.creator: Niket Nishant, Utkarsh Hathi
items.summary: Os principais índices acionários dos Estados Unidos caíam nesta segunda-feira, depois que ataques militares entre os EUA e o Irã elevaram os preços do petróleo, alimentando temores de inflação após as declarações hawkish do chair do Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh.
items.body:
Os principais índices acionários dos Estados Unidos caíam nesta segunda-feira, depois que ataques militares entre os EUA e o Irã elevaram os preços do petróleo, alimentando temores de inflação após as declarações hawkish do chair do Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh.
As perdas podem definir o tom para setembro, mês que costuma ser fraco para o mercado de ações, e provavelmente aumentarão a pressão na reunião do Federal Reserve no próximo mês.
Operadores estimam uma probabilidade de mais de 60% de um aumento dos juros na reunião do Fed em setembro, de acordo com o FedWatch da CME, um aumento acentuado em relação aos 41,4% registrados há uma semana, depois que Warsh afirmou que as autoridades talvez precisem aumentar os custos dos empréstimos caso a inflação não recue para a meta de 2% do banco central.
“Ele (Warsh) tirou de cena qualquer possibilidade de um corte (nos juros)”, disse Thomas Kikis, diretor de mercados para os EUA e as Américas do Standard Chartered.
Os comentários de Warsh, proferidos na sexta-feira no simpósio do Fed em Jackson Hole, ocorreram após dados contraditórios nas últimas semanas.
Um relatório sobre a inflação ao consumidor divulgado este mês mostrou que as pressões sobre os preços foram moderadas em julho, mas o índice de preços PCE, o indicador preferido do Fed, ficou acima do esperado.
Essa ambiguidade pode aumentar a importância do relatório mensal de emprego dos EUA que será divulgado na sexta-feira. Relatórios recentes não indicaram que “as tendências subjacentes tenham melhorado significativamente”, disse Warsh na sexta-feira.
O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caía 0,65%, para 53.209,24 pontos, enquanto o S&P 500 (.SPX) tinha queda de 0,40%, para 7.681,27 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuava 0,29%, para 26.325,31 pontos.
Os confrontos militares entre os EUA e o Irã foram retomados no Oriente Médio, onde a interrupção no Estreito de Ormuz tem impedido o transporte de petróleo.
As ações do setor de energia (.SPNY) subiam após um ganho de 1,71% nos preços do petróleo Brent , com a Halliburton (HAL.N) e a Valero Energy (VLO.N) registrando altas de 4,26% e 1,90%, respectivamente.

items.title: Safra de soja 26/27 do Brasil é estimada em recorde de 184,1 mi t, diz AgResource
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Brasil poderá colher um recorde de 184,1 milhões de toneladas de soja em 2026/27, segundo estimativa inicial da consultoria AgResource Brasil, que vê uma área plantada estável na comparação com o ciclo anterior, segundo relatório divulgado nesta segunda-feira.
items.body:
O Brasil poderá colher um recorde de 184,1 milhões de toneladas de soja em 2026/27, segundo estimativa inicial da consultoria AgResource Brasil, que vê uma área plantada estável na comparação com o ciclo anterior, segundo relatório divulgado nesta segunda-feira.
A AgResource considera que a produção brasileira poderá crescer 3,6 milhões de toneladas, ou 2,0%, no comparativo com 2025/26, com um ganho de produtividade apesar da ocorrência do fenômeno climático El Niño.
Os impactos negativos do El Niño no centro-norte do país, região que normalmente fica mais seca e quente sob influência do fenômeno, serão compensados por ganhos de produtividade nos Estados do Sul, que geralmente recebem mais chuvas.
"O El Niño não derruba a safra brasileira: ele desloca produção de uma ponta do país para a outra", apontou o relatório.
Segundo o relatório, o número de safra incorpora um desconto de 4,9 milhões de toneladas atribuído ao El Niño e fica 1,9 milhão de toneladas abaixo da projeção do Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA (USDA).
Segundo a AgResource, duas premissas explicam a distância para o USDA. A primeira é a área: a AgResource não trabalha com expansão em 2026/27.
"Com área parada, todo o ganho de 2,0% sobre a safra passada vem de produtividade, e não de hectare novo. A segunda é o clima, que responde pelos 4,9 MMT de desconto sobre a mesma base de área sem El Niño."

items.title: China's Xi tells Putin that foundations of ties will be stronger
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping on Monday told Russian President Vladimir Putin that under their "strategic guidance and joint efforts", the foundations of bilateral ties will be stronger, with brighter prospects, China's state-run Xinhua reported.
items.body:
Chinese President Xi Jinping on Monday told Russian President Vladimir Putin that under their "strategic guidance and joint efforts", the foundations of bilateral ties will be stronger, with brighter prospects, China's state-run Xinhua reported.
"Uncertainties and unpredictable factors in the international situation have increased markedly," Xi said, adding that people's pursuit of peace, development and cooperation remained unchanged.
China is willing to work with Russia and others to "strengthen the forces leading the reform of global governance and advancing an equal and orderly multipolar world", Xi said during the meeting on the sidelines of a Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Kyrgyzstan.
The two also discussed international and regional issues of common concern, Xinhua said.

items.title: Warsh dice al G20 que previo exceso de ahorro mundial se está convirtiendo en un auge de inversión
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, dijo el lunes ante los ministros de Economía del G20 que el mundo está experimentando un auge de la inversión que está contribuyendo a impulsar el crecimiento, revirtiendo así el exceso de ahorro del pasado que mantenía el capital inactivo por escasez de oportunidades de inversión.
items.body:
El presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, dijo el lunes ante los ministros de Economía del G20 que el mundo está experimentando un auge de la inversión que está contribuyendo a impulsar el crecimiento, revirtiendo así el exceso de ahorro del pasado que mantenía el capital inactivo por escasez de oportunidades de inversión.
Warsh, que asiste a su primera reunión internacional sobre política económica desde que asumió el cargo en mayo, dijo en la sesión plenaria inaugural del G20 que espera con interés conocer más detalles sobre las perspectivas de crecimiento de las economías miembros.
Señaló que, durante anteriores reuniones del G20, incluso antes de la crisis financiera mundial de 2008 y en los años posteriores, los participantes habrían debatido sobre "un exceso de ahorro a nivel mundial", pero la situación se ha invertido.
"Si tuviera que caracterizar este momento, diría que se trata de un auge mundial de la inversión", dijo, y añadió que el concepto de estancamiento secular ya no era aplicable.

items.title: US farm agency moves to support beef industry
items.author: Leah Douglas
items.creator: Leah Douglas
items.summary: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said on Monday that the USDA is taking actions to support the beef industry, including loans for small meat processors and the use of conserved land for grazing.
items.body:
U.S. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said on Monday that the USDA is taking actions to support the beef industry, including loans for small meat processors and the use of conserved land for grazing.
President Donald Trump on Friday pledged [USN:FWN44P1S5 TEXT:"action "]to allow ranchers to process their own cattle, aimed at breaking up a "nasty monopoly" among top meatpackers.
U.S. shoppers have faced record beef prices as drought and wildfires have driven the cattle herd to 75-year lows. Trump last week signed an [USN:FWN44N147 TEXT:"order "]expanding lower-tariff beef imports in an effort to bring down prices, angering farm groups.
Among the USDA's efforts are a guaranteed loan program for smaller meat processing operations and allowing ranchers to use some conserved lands after natural disasters and wildfires, according to an agency press release.
"We are investing real dollars to rebuild the Great American Beef Herd, giving producers the risk management tools they need, cutting the red tape that has squeezed small and independent operators, and demanding transparency in a marketplace that has been consolidated and foreign-owned for far too long," said Rollins in the release.
items.raw_description: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said on Monday that the USDA is taking actions to support the beef industry, including loans for small meat processors and the use of conserved land for grazing.

items.title: Orioles' Gunnar Henderson eager to pick up steam vs. Rockies
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Baltimore is right in the thick of the American League wild-card race and Gunnar Henderson is heating up in time for the final stretch.
items.body:
Baltimore is right in the thick of the American League wild-card race and Gunnar Henderson is heating up in time for the final stretch.
The Orioles shortstop went deep for the first time since Aug. 14 with a pair of homers in Sunday's 8-5 win at the Athletics and finished 4-for-4 with a triple and five RBIs. He brings that momentum into the opener of a three-game series against the Colorado Rockies on Monday in Denver.
Colorado will send right-hander Tanner Gordon (1-4, 5.38 ERA) to the mound. The Orioles did not immediately name a starter.
An All-Star in 2024, Henderson has not produced at that level for most of 2026. He was batting .214 in mid-August but a pair of four-hit games has raised the average to .223 heading into the series at hitter-friendly Coors Field.
His recent surge has coincided with the team's rise in the standings. Baltimore has won seven of its last nine games following a sweep of the Athletics, and sits one game back of Cleveland for the final playoff berth.
The Orioles were scuffling after losing four in a row before this recent success, and it has given them confidence going into the final month of the season.
"We've done such a good job of not pressing and panicking and trying to do too much," said right-hander Shane Baz, who got the win in Saturday night's victory over the A's.
"It's fun to be in this spot. I think we have all the tools to make a run. We've got great leadership. We've got a great team with a lot of talent."
There was a scary moment in Sunday's win, as Pete Alonso was hit in the brim of the helmet by a fastball. He came out of the game as a precaution but was moving around the dugout without issue.
Rockies rookie Cole Carrigg won't be in the starting lineup Monday and didn't start in Sunday's loss at Atlanta, although he was used as a pinch hitter in the seventh and played in the outfield the rest of the game.
Manager Warren Schaeffer sat Carrigg on Sunday, one day after he gave the middle finger to Braves fans after he failed to make a diving catch on a two-run double in the eighth by Michael Harris II.
"Cole made a mistake -- he knows that is an embarrassment to the organization and that we don't stand for that," Schaeffer said Sunday. "Listen, everybody makes mistakes. It's just one that he has to learn from. It's just that we will not put up with that here.
"So he is going to sit a couple days, because he's a guy that wants to play every day. That's the repercussions of this."
Gordon, who has never faced Baltimore, is tasked with stopping Colorado's slide. The Rockies were swept in Atlanta and have lost four in a row and 11 of 13 since finishing 5-4 on a road trip two weeks ago.
Gordon recorded his first win of the season on Wednesday after allowing one run on six hits in seven innings of a 13-1 romp over the Washington Nationals.
--Field Level Media

items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social (BNDES) aprovou financiamento de R$300 milhões para o grupo sueco de eletrodomésticos Electrolux investir em pesquisa e desenvolvimento, anunciou a instituição financeira nesta segunda feira.
items.body:
O Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social (BNDES) aprovou financiamento de R$300 milhões para o grupo sueco de eletrodomésticos Electrolux (ELUXb.ST) investir em pesquisa e desenvolvimento, anunciou a instituição financeira nesta segunda feira.
Segundo o BNDES, o projeto da Electrolux contempla o desenvolvimento de tecnologias para 26 novos produtos no Brasil, como geladeiras, aparelhos de ar-condicionado e fornos, além de robôs aspiradores de pó.
As novas tecnologias focam no menor gasto de energia e no uso da inteligência artificial.
"Este projeto está relacionado com o desenvolvimento da indústria com tecnologia de ponta e de produtos mais eficientes e econômicos...A operação também envolve uma maior capacidade de exportação dos eletrodomésticos produzidos aqui", afirmou o presidente do BNDES, Aloizio Mercadante, em nota.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kalshi permanently banned former U.S. congressman George Santos from its platform on Monday and imposed a penalty of $71,356, citing insider trading.
items.body:
Kalshi permanently banned former U.S. congressman George Santos from its platform on Monday and imposed a penalty of $71,356, citing insider trading.
The company said in a disciplinary action that its compliance department had found reasonable cause to believe the former lawmaker engaged in illicit trading.
The move comes as prediction market platforms Kalshi and Polymarket have seen a rise in suspicious trading activity, presenting new compliance challenges as regulators and law enforcement intensify scrutiny of the growing sector.
Kalshi had reported Santos to the U.S. Department of Justice in June after detecting suspicious trading activity from his account on the platform, [USN:L4N42B145 TEXT:"a source told Reuters"] at the time.
Santos was expelled from Congress over fraud and identity theft. U.S. President Donald Trump commuted his over-seven-year prison sentence last year.

items.title: イラン、米再攻撃なら報復と警告　トランプ氏「終わった国」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３１日　ロイター］ - イラン高官筋は３１日、ロイターに対し、米国とイランの間で新たに発生した武力衝突は依然として「限定的かつ抑制された対立」にとどまっているとの認識を示した。

同時に、米国が再び攻撃を実施した場合、イランは激しい報復を行う用意があると警告した。

高官は「この地域において、イランの手の届かない標的は存在しない」とした上で、イランの定めた規則に従わない船舶について「ホルムズ海峡の状況はさらに悪化するだろう」と警告した。

米当局者によると、米軍は３０日、イランのララク島にある発射装置２基を攻撃。米国によるイラン攻撃が明らかになるのは７月下旬以来。これに対し、イラン外務省は報復措置として、ヨルダンの米軍基地を攻撃したと発表した。

トランプ米大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に、「イランは破綻し、終わった国だ」と投稿。「海軍も空軍も通貨もなく、兵士や警察官に給料も支払えていない。インフレ率は３００％に達し、指導部は完全に混乱状態にあり、国を適切に代表する能力を失っている」とし、イランに残されているのは「フェイク（偽）ニュースと抗議者を殺害する意思、たわごとだけだ」と主張した。

ベセント米財務長官は３１日、ＣＮＢＣとのインタビューで、対イラン制裁の目標はイランを「交渉のテーブルに着かせたいと思わせる状況を作り出すこと」だと説明。イラン問題を巡っては「中国との間で相違点よりも共通点の方が多い」との見方も示した。

ベセント長官はこれに先立ち、２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）財務相・中央銀行総裁会議の会場で記者団に対し、イランが米国の制裁を深刻に受け止めており、経済的損失を被っていることから軍事的な反撃に出ているとの見解を示した。その上で「イランに対する圧力をかけ続ける」と語った。

items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las estadounidenses Chevron y GE Vernova , la india ONGC, la italiana Eni y la colombiana GeoPark están a punto de firmar acuerdos definitivos en Venezuela tras meses de negociaciones para concretar proyectos energéticos en el país miembro de la OPEP, según informaron cuatro fuentes cercanas a los preparativos.
items.body:
Las estadounidenses Chevron (CVX.N) y GE Vernova (GEV.N) , la india ONGC, la italiana Eni (ENI.MI) y la colombiana GeoPark (GPRK.N) están a punto de firmar acuerdos definitivos en Venezuela tras meses de negociaciones para concretar proyectos energéticos en el país miembro de la OPEP, según informaron cuatro fuentes cercanas a los preparativos.
Los acuerdos, que podrían firmarse esta misma semana, son independientes del importante pacto entre Caracas y Washington anunciado la semana pasada mediante el cual Estados Unidos asegurará una participación en 17 yacimientos petrolíferos con aproximadamente 64.000 millones de barriles de reservas probadas, una quinta parte de las reservas totales de crudo de Venezuela.
Eni declaró que está trabajando con sus contrapartes venezolanas y otras autoridades para "apoyar la revitalización del sector energético del país". Chevron, GE Vernova, ONGC y GeoPark no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios.

items.title: Football-Bradley Barcola a signé au Liverpool FC
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le Liverpool FC a annoncé lundi la signature de l'international français Bradley Barcola en provenance du Paris Saint-Germain.
items.body:
Le Liverpool FC a annoncé lundi la signature de l'international français Bradley Barcola en provenance du Paris Saint-Germain.
Selon les médias britanniques, Bradley Barcola a signé un contrat de cinq ans pour une valeur totale de 162 millions de dollars (environ 140 millions d'euros).
"Cela a pris un long moment, mais je suis très heureux aujourd'hui de pouvoir jouer pour Liverpool et tout ce que je veux, c'est être sur le terrain et en mesure de jouer", a déclaré le nouveau Red sur le site du club.
"J'espère accomplir de grandes choses. Tout d'abord, gagner la Premier League. C'est l'un des plus grands rêves de ma vie."
Formé à l'Olympique lyonnais, le joueur de 23 ans arrive en Angleterre après un passage réussi au PSG où il a gagné trois fois le titre de champions de France et surtout réussi le doublé en Ligue des Champions.
En 152 apparitions sous le maillot parisien, Bradley Barcola a marqué 39 buts et réalisé 37 passes décisives.
Bradley Barcola rejoint deux autres Français à Liverpool, le défenseur Jérémy Jacquet et l'attaquant Hugo Ekitiké, qui se remet d'une rupture du tendon d'Achille.

items.title: Les partis du Kosovo s’accordent pour élire un président
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le parti du Premier ministre par intérim du Kosovo Albin Kurti, Vetevendosje (VV), et la Ligue démocratique du Kosovo (LDK), parti d'opposition, sont convenus lundi de soutenir l'élection d'un nouveau président, une initiative qui pourrait mettre fin à près de deux ans d'impasse politique.
items.body:
Le parti du Premier ministre par intérim du Kosovo Albin Kurti, Vetevendosje (VV), et la Ligue démocratique du Kosovo (LDK), parti d'opposition, sont convenus lundi de soutenir l'élection d'un nouveau président, une initiative qui pourrait mettre fin à près de deux ans d'impasse politique.
Le candidat proposé, Bekim Sejdiu, 51 ans, est professeur de droit à l’université de Pristina. Il a auparavant été ambassadeur du Kosovo en Turquie et consul général à New York.
Albin Kurti, dont le parti a remporté les élections législatives anticipées du 7 juin, n’a besoin que de quelques voix de partis représentant les minorités pour former un gouvernement. Il ne dispose toutefois pas de la majorité des deux tiers nécessaire à l’élection d’un président.
Le Kosovo, l’un des pays les plus pauvres d’Europe, aspire à rejoindre l’Union européenne. Bruxelles a à plusieurs reprises déclaré que le pays devait disposer d’institutions stables capables de mener à bien les réformes nécessaires à son adhésion. L’instabilité politique a retardé les réformes et ralenti l’accès aux fonds de l’UE.
Avec plusieurs partis représentant les minorités, les deux formations peuvent réunir plus de 80 voix, le nombre requis pour élire un président, une fonction essentiellement honorifique. Vetevendosje a remporté 53 des 120 sièges du Parlement, tandis que la LDK est arrivée troisième avec 18 sièges.
"Nous espérons et sommes convaincus que la République du Kosovo, comme elle l’a si souvent fait par le passé, trouvera une nouvelle fois le moyen d’aller de l’avant et de relever les défis majeurs qui nous attendent", a déclaré Bekim Sejdiu lors d’une conférence de presse à l’issue de la conclusion de l’accord.
L’échec de l’élection d’un nouveau président avait déclenché les élections législatives anticipées de juin, les troisièmes élections nationales organisées dans le pays en moins de 18 mois.

items.title: Fabricantes chinesas de baterias se unem a brasileiras para ampliar disputa em leilão
items.author: Leticia Augusto
items.creator: Leticia Augusto
items.summary: Fabricantes chinesas de sistemas de armazenamento de energia, como Jinko ESS e CATL, estão fechando parcerias com empresas brasileiras do segmento para nacionalizar projetos e garantir uma participação maior no leilão inédito para a tecnologia, marcado para dezembro.
items.body:
Fabricantes chinesas de sistemas de armazenamento de energia, como Jinko ESS e CATL, estão fechando parcerias com empresas brasileiras do segmento para nacionalizar projetos e garantir uma participação maior no leilão inédito para a tecnologia, marcado para dezembro.
A Jinko ESS, do grupo JinkoSolar Holding Co. , anunciou nesta segunda-feira um memorando de entendimento (MoU) com a UCB Power para explorar a nacionalização de sistemas de armazenamento de energia.
A ideia é que os projetos desenvolvidos em parceria possam atender aos requisitos de conteúdo local colocados para uma das duas contratações de baterias para o setor elétrico brasileiro, a do [USN:L1N42B0FQ TEXT:"dia 2 de dezembro"], destinada exclusivamente para baterias "nacionais".
O sistema de armazenamento de energia poderá ser considerado [USN:L1N4100HR TEXT:""nacional""] mesmo contendo células importadas, já que o Brasil não tem capacidade de produção desse componente fundamental para as baterias. Já a nacionalização envolveria o restante do sistema: "packs" de baterias, software de gerenciamento, inversores e outras infraestruturas.
"A nacionalização também poderá facilitar o acesso a alternativas de financiamento disponíveis no Brasil, incluindo linhas do BNDES", afirmou Vinicius Berná, diretor-executivo comercial e de novos negócios da UCB Power, em nota.
Na mesma linha, a chinesa CATL (300750.SZ) anunciou na semana passada uma parceria estratégica com a Moura, fabricante brasileira tradicional do segmento, para participação conjunta no leilão de dezembro.
"Essa colaboração combina as soluções avançadas de armazenamento de energia da CATL com a profunda expertise local da Moura, contando com o apoio de um segundo parceiro estratégico, líder de mercado em inversores no país, e visando a produção local que atenda aos requisitos de conteúdo local do leilão", disseram as empresas, em comunicado.
Os anúncios da Jinko ESS e CATL não mencionam investimentos potenciais na industrialização de baterias no Brasil.
O primeiro leilão de baterias do Brasil recebeu [USN:L1N4400MC TEXT:"cadastramento recorde"], de mais de 296 gigawatts (GW) em projetos.
Além da disputa para baterias nacionais, haverá uma segunda concorrência, em 4 de dezembro, para todo tipo de empreendimento, sem exigência de conteúdo local.
O certame é amplamente aguardado pelo setor elétrico brasileiro, já que ampliará o leque de recursos de segurança energética do Brasil em meio ao forte crescimento das fontes renováveis de energia. Mas corre o [USN:L1N44N0WN TEXT:"risco de ser judicializado"], devido a uma disputa sobre quem arcará com os custos da contratação desses sistemas.

Aug 31 : OpenAI on Monday said ChatGPT Ads, the company's advertising business, has reached $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate, as adoption picks up and global expansion rolls out.
The company started testing ads in ChatGPT U.S. earlier this year and has steadily expanded to add advertisers and tap into more markets, as it banks on advertising to boost overall revenue growth ahead of a potential IPO. 
Here are more details: 
• Starting on Monday, advertisers across India, Europe, the Middle East and North Africa can purchase ChatGPT ads directly via OpenAI's Ads Manager — a tool it has already rolled out in the United States.

• OpenAI has been displaying ads to users on ChatGPT's free tier and the lower-priced Go plan. In April, OpenAI had said its ads pilot in the U.S. crossed $100 million in annualized revenue within six weeks of its launch.

items.title: India's ONGC to invest $10.5 billion for deepwater exploration, chairman says
items.author: Nidhi Verma
items.creator: Nidhi Verma
items.summary: India's Oil and Natural Gas Corp aims to invest 1 trillion rupees ($10.51 billion) over five years to explore its local deepwater and ultradeep water fields, Chairman A.K. Singh said on Monday.
items.body:
India's Oil and Natural Gas Corp (ONGC.NS) aims to invest 1 trillion rupees ($10.51 billion) over five years to explore its local deepwater and ultradeep water fields, Chairman A.K. Singh said on Monday.
ONGC will drill 87 deepwater and ultradeep water wells by March 2031, he said during a news conference.
India has huge untapped reserves of oil and gas in deepwater blocks, and there are now technologies available to tap those resources, Singh said.
The state-owned integrated oil and gas company needs major discoveries to arrest the decline in its oil and gas output, as India's crude oil production fell in fiscal 2026 for the 11th year in a row.
Singh said ONGC would also invest about 70 billion rupees for building 1.75 million tonnes of strategic petroleum reserve (SPR) at Mangalore in southern India.
India, the world's third biggest oil importer and consumer, is gradually [USN:L4N4400PV TEXT:"enhancing"] its strategic petroleum reserve capacity to handle global crude oil volatilities and pricing.
He said the government wants ONGC to build this SPR, for which the company has already acquired land.
Separately, he said ONGC hopes to set up a [USN:L4N3UI0JP TEXT:"trading unit"] either in Dubai or Singapore by the end of March 2027 through a joint venture with a global company. The planned joint venture could annually trade 50 million tonnes of crude oil, refined fuels and gas.
Apart from trading ONGC group companies' products, the JV will also trade third party volumes, he added.
($1 = 95.1625 Indian rupees)

items.title: Firms including Chevron, ONGC, GE Vernova on track to sign final pacts in Venezuela, sources say
items.author: Marianna Parraga, Deisy Buitrago
items.creator: Marianna Parraga, Deisy Buitrago
items.summary: U.S. companies Chevron and GE Vernova , India's ONGC, Italy's Eni and Colombia's GeoPark are on track to sign final agreements in Venezuela after months of negotiations to firm up energy projects in the OPEC country, five sources close to the preparations said.
items.body:
U.S. companies Chevron (CVX.N) and GE Vernova (GEV.N) , India's ONGC, Italy's Eni (ENI.MI) and Colombia's GeoPark (GPRK.N) are on track to sign final agreements in Venezuela after months of negotiations to firm up energy projects in the OPEC country, five sources close to the preparations said.
Most pacts imply completion of a six-month [USN:L1N43W0HD TEXT:"migration"] of oil contracts to an amended hydrocarbon law now giving more flexibility to foreign companies to operate oilfields, export the barrels and cash sale proceeds, the sources said. Others set terms for new energy and electricity projects.
The list of companies lining up to sign has not been finalized as executives have rushed to complete negotiations at the last minute, two of the sources said.
The agreements, which could be inked as early as this week, are separate from a massive Caracas-Washington [USN:L1N44R06U TEXT:"pact"] announced last week for the U.S. to lock in a stake in 17 oilfields with some 64 billion barrels of proved reserves, a fifth of Venezuela's total crude reserves.
Chevron's agreements with Venezuela are expected to be "of significant size," one of the sources said.
The company is trying to add a block in the vast Orinoco Belt to its portfolio, which would allow one of its joint projects with state-run PDVSA to expand, two sources said, and Chevron also aims to negotiate an area in Monagas North that could become a key source of diluents for its extra heavy oil output.
Eni said it was working with its Venezuelan counterparties and any other authorities to "support the revitalization of the country's energy sector."
Chevron, GE Vernova, ONGC and GeoPark did not immediately reply to requests for comment.
Venezuela's oil ministry and state-run energy firm PDVSA did not reply to a request for comment.

items.author: Christina Amann, Rachel More
items.creator: Christina Amann, Rachel More
items.summary: Im Ringen um eine Zukunft von vier Volkswagen-Werken in Deutschland fordert Sachsens Ministerpräsident Michael Kretschmer Unterstützung durch die Politik. Bundespolitisch und in der Europäischen Union seien jetzt Weichenstellungen nötig, sagte Kretschmer der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Montag. Quoten und Strafzahlungen passten nicht in die Zeit, sagte er mit Blick auf EU-Vorgaben zur Senkung der CO2-Emissionen von Autos. Zölle der EU auf Plug-in-Hybride aus China könnten ein Baustein in einem Lösungskonzept sein, reichten aber allein nicht aus. "Wir haben die gesamte Breite zu betrachten", sagte Kretschmer. "Es geht nicht nur um Volkswagen. Es ist die deutsche Industrie, die derzeit leidet."
items.body:
Im Ringen um eine Zukunft von vier Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) -Werken in Deutschland fordert Sachsens Ministerpräsident Michael Kretschmer Unterstützung durch die Politik. Bundespolitisch und in der Europäischen Union seien jetzt Weichenstellungen nötig, sagte Kretschmer der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Montag. Quoten und Strafzahlungen passten nicht in die Zeit, sagte er mit Blick auf EU-Vorgaben zur Senkung der CO2-Emissionen von Autos. Zölle der EU auf Plug-in-Hybride aus China könnten ein Baustein in einem Lösungskonzept sein, reichten aber allein nicht aus. "Wir haben die gesamte Breite zu betrachten", sagte Kretschmer. "Es geht nicht nur um Volkswagen. Es ist die deutsche Industrie, die derzeit leidet."
Europas größter Autobauer ringt derzeit um ein umfassendes Sparpaket, bei dem unter anderem Zehntausende Stellen gestrichen werden könnten und die langfristige Zukunft von vier Werken in Deutschland auf der Kippe steht, darunter auch die VW-Fabrik im sächsischen Zwickau. Neben Fehlentscheidungen des Unternehmens in den vergangenen Jahren habe auch die fehlende Wettbewerbsfähigkeit in Deutschland den Standort in Schwierigkeiten gebracht, sagte der CDU-Politiker. "Und da müssen wir alle miteinander anpacken. Nicht mit Subventionen, nicht mit Zöllen, sondern mit Deregulierung", ergänzte Kretschmer. "Es muss einfach in Deutschland besser, einfacher und kostengünstiger werden, zu produzieren." Ein Element könnte dabei auch eine längere Arbeitszeit von 40 Stunden pro Woche sein. Geringere Energiekosten nannte er als weiteren Punkt.
Eine Entscheidung über die Zukunft des Standorts Zwickau mit seinen rund 8000 Beschäftigten müsse in den kommenden Monaten getroffen werden, betonte Kretschmer. Die Diskussion zehre an den Nerven der Menschen, und neue Modelle müssten rechtzeitig auf den Weg gebracht werden. "Diese ganze Diskussion ist verheerend für die Produktivität." Er sei dazu in engem Kontakt mit dem Vorstand und dem Aufsichtsrat von VW. "Es muss nach sauberen, nachvollziehbaren Kriterien gehen, welche Werke welche Fahrzeuge produzieren."

items.title: US lawyer who defended Trump ballroom, White House policies rejoins Jones Day
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: A top U.S. Justice Department lawyer has left to rejoin law firm Jones Day after playing a lead role defending key policies and initiatives of President Donald Trump’s administration.
items.body:
A top U.S. Justice Department lawyer has left to rejoin law firm Jones Day after playing a lead role defending key policies and initiatives of President Donald Trump’s administration.
Ohio-based Jones Day said Yaakov Roth is returning to the firm on Sept. 8 as a partner in Washington after a year and a half in his role near the top of the Justice Department’s civil division.
Roth defended the administration in the lower and appeals courts against lawsuits challenging Trump’s $400 million ballroom project on the site of the White House's demolished East Wing. The administration is [USN:S0N42U037 TEXT:"appealing"] an order that found the project unlawful.
In other cases, Roth early last year oversaw litigation involving Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the man who a judge said the administration [USN:S0N3XA073 TEXT:"wrongly deported"] to El Salvador. He also was the lead attorney defending White House [USN:L1N3WY09M TEXT:"restrictions"] on Associated Press access.
Roth joined the Justice Department last year and served at first for four months as the acting assistant attorney general for the civil division, and then as the division’s principal deputy. He argued 11 appeals on the government's behalf, pushing his career total to more than 50, Jones Day said.
In a post on LinkedIn, Roth, a former law clerk to the late U.S. Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia, called his service at the Justice Department “an intense and exhilarating experience as we faced an unprecedented surge of civil litigation targeting the new Administration’s agenda.”
The 2,400-lawyer firm, known for its corporate defense work, represented Donald Trump in his 2016 and 2020 presidential campaigns. Several of its lawyers have held top posts in the first and second Trump administrations. The Civil Division is [USN:L2N3PA0EQ TEXT:"led"] by Senate-confirmed appointee Brett Shumate, who was also a partner at Jones Day.
Roth's past clients at the firm have included KalshiEX, Walmart, Eli Lilly, TikTok and Huawei, according to a financial disclosure that Roth filed when he joined the Justice Department. The disclosure, a mandatory filing for many senior-level executive branch officials, showed his partnership income was more than $7.1 million at Jones Day.

items.title: ネパール・中国国境の洪水、行方不明が4800人に急増－死者919人確認
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ネパールと中国では、氷河崩壊に伴う洪水や土砂災害で少なくとも919人が死亡、約4800人が依然として行方不明となっている。救助隊は孤立した地域への到達に難航している。

救助活動が6日目に入る中、行方不明者は急増している。ネパールでは903人が死亡し、4247人が行方不明と報告された。中国当局によると、チベット自治区吉隆県では16人が死亡、546人が行方不明となっている。

ネパール独立発電事業者協会によると、今回の災害では主要インフラも被害を受け、ヌワコット、ラスワ両郡にある少なくとも12カ所の水力発電事業が損壊した。公式データによると、水力発電事業だけで933人が行方不明となっている。

ネパール軍のゴータム報道官によると、軍は複数の水力発電事業のトンネル内に取り残された人々の救助活動を続けている。中国、インド、南アフリカのチームが各地で軍の活動を支援しているという。

ネパール国家災害リスク軽減管理庁はXへの投稿で、約2万人の治安要員が動員され、1万人以上が救助されたと明らかにした。

アジア最貧国の1つであるネパールは、大規模な復興を迫られている。イラン戦争に伴う燃料費の上昇に加え、観光業が低迷し、経済成長が鈍化している。今回の災害は、「Z世代」の不満の高まりを追い風に今年初めに政権を握ったシャハ首相（36）が直面する課題を一段と深刻化させている。

今回の災害は26日の氷河崩壊が引き金となった。氷や泥、岩石、激しい濁流がネパールの渓谷を襲い、集落をのみ込んだほか、道路が寸断されて村々が孤立した。映像には、水や土砂が建物をのみ込み、橋や送電線を破壊し、車両を押し流す中、人々が逃げようとする様子が映っていた。がれきや泥、水の下には依然として被災者が閉じ込められているとみられる。

カナル外相は29日、救助・復旧活動に必要な専門的な支援を外国に求めていると明らかにした。ネパールは、人々が閉じ込められたトンネルの開通、孤立地域への物資輸送に使う大型ドローン、犠牲者の身元確認に必要な法医学的支援を要請した。

items.title: India's ITC arm to acquire 22.1% stake in IT firm Happiest Minds for $140 million
items.author: Urvi Dugar, Sai B
items.creator: Urvi Dugar, Sai B
items.summary: India's ITC said on Monday its IT unit will buy a 22.1% stake in Happiest Minds Technologies for about 13.3 billion rupees ($139.76 million) in cash, and that ITC Infotech would list on the BSE and the NSE after the deal.
items.body:
India's ITC (ITC.NS) said on Monday its IT unit will buy a 22.1% stake in Happiest Minds Technologies (HAPP.NS) for about 13.3 billion rupees ($139.76 million) in cash, and that ITC Infotech would list on the BSE (BSEL.NS) and the NSE after the deal.
The combined entity will set a target of $1 billion in revenue in the fiscal year ending 2028, ITC said in an exchange filing.
The ITC deal, part of a merger with the IT services provider, will take between three and eight months to complete.
Indian IT firms are racing to bulk up their capabilities through big-ticket buyouts to combat AI-led disruption.
Coforge (COFO.NS) [USN:L4N3XW0F6 TEXT:"acquired"] engineering company Encora in a $2.3 billion deal last year and Persistent Systems (PERS.NS) plans to [USN:L6N43107T TEXT:"acquire"] Germany-based Nagarro for $1.1 billion.
"This should be viewed as an opportunity for backdoor listing for ITC Infotech and get to (the) $1 billion revenue figure faster. The midcaps will continue to outperform large caps due to (smaller) size, limited offerings plus geographical risks," said Gaurav Vasu, founder of market intelligence firm UnearthInsight.
Reuters reported earlier this month that [USN:L1N40R0IW TEXT:"competition"] between India's mid-sized IT firms and larger rivals has turned fierce as AI lowers barriers and levels the playing field.
Shareholders of Happiest Minds will receive 25 shares of ITC Infotech for every 81 shares held in the company. ITC will be the promoter of the merged company, with a 73.4% stake, Happiest Minds said in a separate release.
($1 = 95.1625 Indian rupees)

items.title: Shein prices Hong Kong IPO below top end of range, raises $1.74 billion
items.author: Nikita Jino, Roshan Thomas, Yantoultra Ngui
items.creator: Nikita Jino, Roshan Thomas, Yantoultra Ngui
items.summary: Shein on Monday priced its Hong Kong initial public offering below the top end of its marketed range, raising HK$13.60 billion ($1.74 billion) from the share sale.
items.body:
Shein (0625.HK) on Monday priced its Hong Kong initial public offering below the top end of its marketed range, raising HK$13.60 billion ($1.74 billion) from the share sale.
The online fast-fashion retailer offered 280 million shares for the listing at HK$48.56 per share. Last week, it said it would offer shares between HK$47.60 and HK$49.50 apiece.
The Hong Kong public offering portion was subscribed 5.63 times, while the international portion was subscribed 2.59 times, Shein said in a stock exchange filing on Monday.
"Judging by the subscription response, I believe the oversubscription rate is relatively mild," said Kenny Ng, a strategist at China Everbright Securities International in Hong Kong.
"Some investors remain relatively cautious about its valuation" due to fluid international trade policies in recent years and the impact of geopolitical tensions on global consumer sentiment, Ng said.
The Singapore-based, Chinese-founded company's shares are slated to begin trading on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
Existing investors in Shein who participated in the offer include billionaire Michael Bloomberg's family office Willett Advisors, French billionaire entrepreneur and investor Xavier Niel, and Microsoft Corp, the filing showed on Monday.
Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Reliance also bought more shares in Shein, according to the filing, as did Bolivian American billionaire Marcelo Claure's Claure Group, and the SoftBank Vision Fund.
Cornerstone investors were Boyu Capital, Tiger Global Management, General Atlantic, Tencent, Greenwoods Asset Management, Taikang Life Insurance, UBS Asset Management Singapore.
Reuters last week [USN:L1N44M046 TEXT:"reported"] that the retailer's Hong Kong IPO book had been fully covered by investor demand despite growing business and regulatory challenges.
Shares of the fast-fashion retailer [USN:L1N44S08W TEXT:"dropped"] more than 10% in gray-market trading on Monday. Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing [USN:L4N44P0BZ TEXT:"said on Friday"] it would launch options and allow short selling of Shein shares from their trading debut.
Shein has said it would use most of the proceeds from the offering to improve its technology and boost brand awareness and global presence.
REGULATORY ISSUES CLOUD DEBUT The long-awaited market debut comes after the online retailer, known for selling cheap clothing to shoppers in about 160 countries, [USN:L1N44L00S TEXT:"scrapped plans"] to list in New York and London.
Shein has been working to address environmental, social and governance concerns that have triggered regulatory investigations and fines in several countries, complicating previous efforts to take the company public.
The company is currently [USN:L6N43H0P4 TEXT:"under investigation"] by the European Commission and the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. It has said it is actively cooperating with both.
Previous probes resulted in fines in France over alleged fake discounts and in Italy over greenwashing, as fast-fashion retailers come under increased scrutiny from regulators.
Shein [USN:L1N43S02R TEXT:"said in late July"] it swung to a quarterly loss of $99 million after the United States removed an import duty exemption for small packages and after it recorded a $328 million fair-value charge on convertible redeemable preferred shares following an accounting change.
($1 = 7.8379 Hong Kong dollars)

items.title: ICICI Bank's mcap gap with HDFC Bank narrows to over 11-year low of ₹49K cr
items.author: Shilpa Rangarajan
items.summary: ICICI Bank's market capitalisation has risen fourfold over six years, while HDFC Bank's has doubled, narrowing the valuation gap between the two lenders ...
items.body: ICICI Bank's market capitalisation (mcap) is fast catching up with that of India's most valuable lender, HDFC Bank, which currently stands at Rs 10.93 trillion. At Rs 10.43 trillion currently, ICICI Bank is just Rs 49,167 crore behind HDFC Bank's market capitalisation. This latest gap between the two lenders is the lowest  since January 29, 2015 when it stood at Rs 44,568 crore. If ICICI Bank surpasses HDFC Bank, it will become India’s most valuable lender. Among all banks, State Bank of India is currently third, with a market cap of Rs 9.78 trillion, according to Monday's closing data of National Stock Exchange. In mid-July 2023, when HDFC Limited merged with HDFC Bank, the combined market cap of HDFC Bank stood at Rs 12.37 trillion, nearly double ICICI Bank's Rs 6.69 trillion. Since then, HDFC Bank's share price has declined at an annual rate of 4 per cent, while ICICI Bank's price has increased by 16 per cent annually. Beyond margin pressures and steadier growth for ICICI Bank, leadership friction eroded HDFC Bank’s market cap. Atanu Chakraborty’s abrupt resignation in March 2026 wiped out Rs 1.5 trillion in days. By late August, governance concerns and MD & CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan’s planned exit further dragged the valuation down to Rs 10.93 trillion, accelerating ICICI’s convergence.

items.title: 独8月インフレ率2.9％に加速、エネルギー価格上昇　コアは横ばい
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maria Martinez

［ベルリン　３１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Maria Martinez

［ベルリン　３１日　ロイター］ - ドイツ連邦統計庁が３１日発表した８月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）速報値は、欧州連合（ＥＵ）基準（ＨＩＣＰ）で前年比２．９％上昇した。イラン紛争を受けたエネルギー価格の上昇を背景に、７月の２．８％から加速したものの、伸びは予想（３．１％上昇）を下回り、コアインフレ率も安定した。戦争による価格上昇圧力が経済全体にさらに広く波及するとの懸念が和らいだ。

インフレ率上昇の主因はエネルギー価格の伸びの加速。８月のエネルギー価格の上昇率は１０．５％と、７月の８．３％から加速した。

食品とエネルギーを除くコアインフレ率は２．４％と、前月から横ばいだった。

コメルツ銀行のシニアエコノミスト、ラルフ・ゾルフェーン氏は、湾岸地域で事態がこれ以上悪化することはないと予想しており、その結果、エネルギー価格は若干低下するとみている。その上で「ただし、不確実性が続いているため、価格はイラン戦争前の水準を大きく上回る状態が続くだろう」と述べた。

９月１日に発表されるユーロ圏全体の８月のインフレ率は３．３％と、７月の２．９％から伸びが加速すると予想されている。

items.title: Unifor turns focus to Stellantis after wrapping up deals with General Motors, Ford
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Unifor says it will begin contract talks with U.S. automaker Stellantis after ratifying new collective agreements in Canada with General Motors and Ford.
items.body: TORONTO — Unifor says it will begin contract talks with U.S. automaker Stellantis on Tuesday. The talks come after the union ratified new collective agreements in Canada with General Motors and Ford. Unifor said Sunday its members at General Motors voted overwhelmingly in favour of ratifying new contracts with the automaker, with those in Oshawa, St. Catharines and Woodstock voting 80.5 per cent in favour, while members in Ingersoll were 96.5 per cent in support. GM Canada president Jack Uppal says in a news release the new agreements include “meaningful improvements to wages, benefits and job security,” while making sure to “sustain good-paying jobs that have long been a cornerstone of Canada’s automotive industry.” The three-year collective agreements increase wages for full-rate production members to $50.20 per hour and skilled trades workers to $62.71 an hour. The union says its agreements with GM mirror the three per cent annual wage increases reached with Ford, which Unifor selected to kick off its pattern bargaining with the industry. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Aug. 31, 2026.

LONDON, Aug 31 : The English Football League said it is disappointed with UEFA after being forced to re-arrange fixtures in the third round of the League Cup because of a clash with the Champions League.
Everton's home clash with Wolverhampton Wanderers had been set for September 9 but according to the EFL, UEFA subsequently scheduled Liverpool's Champions League tie against Atletico Madrid for the same evening.
Logistical challenges for the police mean Liverpool and Everton cannot play at home on the same day.
"On 28 August we confirmed that the Carabao Cup Round Three tie between Everton and Wolverhampton Wanderers had been scheduled for Wednesday 9 September," an EFL statement said.

items.title: Russian man gets reduced sentence in Finland over Ukraine war crimes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Finnish appeals court said on Monday it had overturned parts of a guilty verdict against a Russian-born man convicted of war crimes in Ukraine, reducing his sentence to 12-1/2 years from life imprisonment.
items.body:
A Finnish appeals court said on Monday it had overturned parts of a guilty verdict against a Russian-born man convicted of war crimes in Ukraine, reducing his sentence to 12-1/2 years from life imprisonment.
Voislav Torden, 39, formerly known as Yan Petrovsky, was found guilty by the Helsinki appeals court of taking part in a 2014 ambush in which 22 Ukrainian soldiers died, reversing a lower court's dismissal of that charge.
But the court overturned Torden's convictions for shooting a wounded Ukrainian soldier and for mutilation, leading to the reduced sentence.
The trial of Torden was a rare case of foreign prosecutors pursuing alleged war crimes stemming from the anti-Kyiv insurgency that Moscow backed in eastern Ukraine, years before its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
The court found Torden guilty of taking part in an ambush in which attackers used a Ukrainian flag to deceive Ukrainian troops before opening fire on them.
"The Court of Appeal finds that Torden is, in count one, liable for the deaths of the 22 Ukrainian soldiers referred to in the indictment and for severely wounding four soldiers," Monday's verdict read.
It also upheld convictions for publishing degrading images of a dead Ukrainian soldier and declaring that his unit would show no mercy and take no prisoners.
Torden's lawyer Heikki Lampela told Reuters his client intended to appeal the guilty verdict on the first count to Finland's supreme court.
Deputy Prosecutor General Jukka Rappe said prosecutors would review the ruling before deciding whether to appeal.
Torden was detained in Finland at Ukraine's request in 2023 as he tried to travel to France. The Finnish supreme court later blocked his extradition to Ukraine.

items.title: Decathlon set to buy 50% of Sport 2000 France to expand ski resort presence
items.author: Helen Reid
items.creator: Helen Reid
items.summary: Decathlon has signed a letter of intent to buy 50% of Sport 2000 France, owned by sports retail group Céraclès Coopérative, in a deal that would expand its presence in French ski resorts, the two companies said on Tuesday.
items.body:
Decathlon has signed a letter of intent to buy 50% of Sport 2000 France, owned by sports retail group Céraclès Coopérative, in a deal that would expand its presence in French ski resorts, the two companies said on Tuesday.
Ceracles' Sport 2000 stores would remain independently operated under a franchise model, but the deal would enable Decathlon to enter the ski rental market and make its products available in the retailer's network of stores in the French Alps and Pyrenees, said Jérémy Angelard, Decathlon's chief business officer for Europe.
"We have to continue to grow and to improve our footprint on products but also on services, because that's a huge part of the sports market that we are touching, but not at the speed that we want," Angelard said in an interview.
Decathlon, which made €16.8 billion ($19.5 billion) in sales across 82 countries last year, has been growing its own brands and seeking to [USN:L4N3J115Z TEXT:"acquire"] specialist retailers as it aims to win a bigger share of the growing sports market.
Mountain sports — including snowsports and hiking equipment — account for around 25% of Decathlon's business in France, but Decathlon only has five stores in the mountains while Sport 2000 has 190, said Angelard.
Through the deal with Céraclès, Decathlon would also get access to the group's other retail chains Mondovélo, Espace Montagne, Ekosport-Rent, WAS We Are Select, S2 Sneakers Specialist, and Urban Soccer. Céraclès has 700 stores in total across France, including 400 Sport 2000 stores, whileDecathlon has 325 stores in the country.
Discussions are underway and the deal remains subject to regulatory approvals, the companies said. They did not disclose the size of the deal.
($1 = 0.8622 euros)

items.title: Kosovo parties strike deal to elect president, breaking deadlock
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The party of Kosovo's caretaker prime minister, Albin Kurti, Vetevendosje (VV) and the opposition Democratic League of Kosovo (LDK) agreed on Monday to back the election of a new president, a move that could break nearly two years of political deadlock.
items.body:
The party of Kosovo's caretaker prime minister, Albin Kurti, Vetevendosje (VV) and the opposition Democratic League of Kosovo (LDK) agreed on Monday to back the election of a new president, a move that could break nearly two years of political deadlock.
The proposed candidate, Bekim Sejdiu, 51, is a law professor at the University of Pristina. He previously served as Kosovo's ambassador to Turkey and as consul general in New York.
Kurti, whose party won the June 7 snap election, needs only a handful of votes from smaller minority parties to form a government. However, he lacks the two-thirds parliamentary majority needed to elect a president.
Kosovo, one of Europe's poorest countries, aims to join the European Union. Brussels has repeatedly said the country needs stable institutions capable of delivering reforms required for membership. Political instability has delayed reforms and slowed access to EU funding.
Together with several minority parties, the two parties can secure more than the 80 votes required to elect a president, a post that is largely ceremonial. Vetevendosje won 53 seats in the 120-member parliament, while the LDK came third with 18.
"We hope and believe that the Republic of Kosovo, as it has so often done in the past, will once again find a way to move forward and confront the major challenges that await us," Sejdiu told a news conference after the agreement was reached.
Failure to elect a new president triggered the June snap election, the country's third national vote in less than 18 months.
It remains unclear when lawmakers will convene to elect a parliamentary speaker, approve a new government and vote on the presidency.
(This story has been corrected to 53 seats, not 58, in paragraph 5.)

items.title: Meta removes ads for fraud apps posing as porn after India sounds alarm
items.author: Munsif Vengattil
items.creator: Munsif Vengattil
items.summary: Meta on Monday removed dozens of advertisements after India flagged a pattern of Facebook and Instagram ads using sexually explicit content to lure users into downloading malware that could steal banking credentials and drain bank accounts.
items.body:
Meta (META.O) on Monday removed dozens of advertisements after India flagged a pattern of Facebook and Instagram ads using sexually explicit content to lure users into downloading malware that could steal banking credentials and drain bank accounts.
India recorded nearly $2.4 billion in cyber-fraud losses in 2025, government data shows, as scam operators increasingly target the country's digital-payments boom.
The government said ads on Facebook and Instagram operating under names such as "Night Play" and "Kyss" directed users to phishing websites. It said it had observed a rise in financial fraud involving what it described as "malicious Android applications masquerading as pornography apps".
Reuters found at least 39 such ads still active after the government advisory was issued on Monday, with many of them using sexually explicit video thumbnails to attract clicks. Meta took down all of the ads shortly after Reuters flagged them to the company, seeking comment on the advisory.
Meta did not respond to Reuters queries.
Reuters is first to report Meta's removal of the ads following the government advisory.
The U.S. technology giant's policies state that ads "must not contain adult nudity and sexual activity". They also prohibit ads for "products, services, schemes or offers using identified deceptive or misleading practices", including those intended to scam users out of money.
It is the second time in recent weeks that India has raised concerns about financial fraud on a major technology platform. [USN:L4N44H0FX TEXT:"Reuters previously reported"] that the government directed Google to shut down hundreds of accounts on its Firebase platform after finding criminals were using the service to impersonate major banks.
Meta had internally projected that scam and banned goods advertising would generate about 10% of its 2024 revenue, or roughly $16 billion, even as the company says it is cracking down on such ads, Reuters reported last year.
One ad, while still active, led to a website promoting a video app that promised hundreds of pornographic videos and round-the-clock content. Access required users to directly download a file named "Movexa.apk" outside an official app store.
India's advisory said the apps could secretly access information stored on users' phones, capture one-time passwords and bank PINs, and transfer money from accounts without the owner's knowledge.

items.title: Ibovespa avança na abertura com aval de blue chips
items.author: Paula Arend Laier
items.creator: Paula Arend Laier
items.summary: O Ibovespa avançava nesta segunda-feira, chegando a ultrapassar 178 mil pontos no melhor momento, em movimento endossado principalmente por Petrobras, enquanto Natura disparava após anunciar mudanças no comando.
items.body:
O Ibovespa avançava nesta segunda-feira, chegando a ultrapassar 178 mil pontos no melhor momento, em movimento endossado principalmente por Petrobras, enquanto Natura disparava após anunciar mudanças no comando.
Por volta de 11h25, a principal referência do mercado acionário brasileiro (.BVSP) subia 0,93%, a 177.303,52 pontos, a caminho do nono pregão seguido com sinal positivo. Na máxima mais cedo, marcou 178.585,94 pontos. Na mínima, chegou a 175.664,62 pontos. O volume financeiro na sessão somava R$5,2 bilhões.
Apesar de distante da mínima intradia de agosto, em meados do mês, quando chegou a trabalhar abaixo de 165 mil pontos, o Ibovespa ainda acumula decréscimo de 0,39% no mês.
Na visão do responsável pela área de renda variável da Criteria, Thiago Pedroso, há uma conjunção de fatores que ajudam a explicar a alta do Ibovespa no dia, incluindo o movimento de investidores estrangeiros.
"Nos últimos dias, estancou a saída de recursos estrangeiros", afirmou.
Após forte saída em boa parte do mês, a B3 registrou cinco pregões seguidos com entrada líquida, o que reduziu o saldo negativo em agosto para quase R$18,5 bilhões até o dia 27. Até o dia 20, estava negativo em R$23,2 bilhões.
Pedroso também destacou a alta de preços de commodities como petróleo e minério de ferro nesta sessão, o que "ajuda bastante".
Ele ainda citou o cenário eleitoral, chamando a atenção para reuniões de candidatos com empresários e banqueiros, além de pesquisas mostrando uma disputa competitiva no segundo turno.
No radar do dia, o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, defendeu que a atual [USN:L1N44S0J5 TEXT:"regra fiscal"] do país seja reforçada, e não substituída.
DESTAQUES PETROBRAS PN avançava 3,03% e PETROBRAS ON (PETR3.SA) subia 3,07%, apoiadas na alta dos preços do petróleo no mercado internacional. O barril sob o contrato Brent registrava elevação de 2,79%, a US$90,56.
VALE ON (VALE3.SA) valorizava-se 0,22%, acompanhando o avanço dos futuros do [USN:L6N44S0MK TEXT:"minério de ferro"] na China. O contrato mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian fechou o pregão diurno com alta de 0,76%.
BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) subia 2,18%, melhor desempenho entre os bancos do Ibovespa, com ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN em alta de 0,54% e BRADESCO PN com ganho de 0,64%. SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT cedia 0,13%.
NATURA ON (NATU3.SA) avançava 6,06%, após anunciar a [USN:L6N44S0P1 TEXT:"renúncia"] do presidente-executivo, João Paulo Ferreira, que será substituído por Alessandro Carlucci, que deixou a presidência do conselho de administração. Fábio Barbosa, membro do conselho consultivo da empresa, foi eleito conselheiro e presidente do colegiado.
EMBRAER ON recuava 1,45%, entre as poucas quedas da sessão, em nova sessão de ajustes. No mês, porém, ainda acumula uma valorização de cerca de 8%.
CASAS BAHIA ON (BHIA3.SA) , que não está no Ibovespa, disparava 45%, a R$0,58, após a Justiça aprovar a [USN:L6N44S0OB TEXT:"antecipação"] dos efeitos do "stay period", suspendendo ações e execuções de dívida contra o grupo antes mesmo da decisão sobre o processamento formal da recuperação judicial.

items.summary: India's Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri said on Monday GRT Jewellers would take a controlling stake in the jewellery retailer for up to 10.34 billion rupees ($108.66 million).
items.body:
India's Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri (TBZL.NS) said on Monday GRT Jewellers would take a controlling stake in the jewellery retailer for up to 10.34 billion rupees ($108.66 million).
GRT Jewellers will acquire a 74.12% stake from the top shareholders of the 162-year-old brand, subject to regulatory approvals. The acquisition will also trigger a mandatory open offer for an additional 26% stake under India's takeover regulations.
Based on TBZ's market capitalisation of 20.38 billion rupees, the stake is valued at about 15.11 billion rupees.
The stake sale comes as India's jewellery retailers are tempering expansion plans and shifting towards lightweight accessories amid record-high gold prices and an [USN:L1N41P1DO TEXT:"increase"] in import tariffs on gold and silver.
Both TBZ and GRT have a strong presence in gold and diamond jewellery, integral to weddings and other auspicious occasions in India, the world's second-largest gold consumer that [USN:L4N41O0EI TEXT:"relies"] on imports to meet nearly all of its demand.
"Getting control will often demand a discount to upgrade stores, improve execution, or absorb integration risk," Akshay D'Souza, a consumer sector consultant, told Reuters.
"Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri also appears to have meaningful debt on the balance sheet and this will lead to lower valuations, especially if recent revenues are supported by a gold bull run."
The company had a net debt of 7.8 billion rupees as of March 2026, according to data from LSEG.
Tribhovandas, which began with a single store in 1864, fits into GRT's strategy to expand its footprint across India through its network of 37 stores, GRT Jewellers' Managing Director GR Ananthapadmanabhan said.
Founded in Chennai in 1964, GRT operates 68 stores across India and one in Singapore.
($1 = 95.1625 Indian rupees)

LONDON, Aug 31 : Colombian right back Daniel Munoz said having the chance to work again with Oliver Glasner was one of the key reasons for following the Austrian coach to Nottingham Forest, after his signing from Crystal Palace was confirmed on Monday.
Glasner, who delivered Palace their first major silverware by winning the FA Cup and UEFA Conference League in consecutive years, swapped Selhurst Park for the City Ground at the end of last season.
The 30-year-old Munoz, a key part of Palace's success under Glasner, has signed a three-year contract with the club holding an option for a further year.
"I think that Oliver Glasner is special, I have a very good relationship with him and we did big things together, it was an incredibly special period," Munoz told Forest's website.

"He's a tireless worker, he's a winner, and I think that's a part of the decision I've made - I know him and I know how he works, how his assistants are, and really they all have the same mentality and I'm on the same wavelength."
Munoz made 46 appearances in all competitions for Palace last season, including 29 in the Premier League, registering four goals and three assists.
He has also made 51 appearances for Colombia and was part of the squad for the 2026 World Cup.
"Daniel is a player who has consistently demonstrated his quality at the highest level, and we are delighted to bring him to Nottingham Forest," Forest's Chief Football Officer, George Syrianos, said.
Forest, who drew with Liverpool at the weekend after losing to Leeds United on the opening day of the Premier League season, could hand Munoz his debut against Tottenham Hotspur on Saturday.

Aug 31 : Liverpool have signed France forward Bradley Barcola from European champions Paris St Germain on a long-term contract, the Premier League club said on Monday.
British media reported that the 23-year-old had signed a five-year deal in a package worth around £120 million ($162 million).
"It took a long time but I'm really happy today to be able to play for Liverpool and all I want is to be on the pitch and be able to play," Barcola told Liverpool's website.
A product of Olympique Lyonnais' academy, Barcola was part of France's squad at this year's World Cup and is known for his pace and dribbling ability.
